        "contents": "# 📦 @zapabob/codex npm publish実行ログ\n\n**実装日時**: 2025-10-30\n**機能**: npmパッケージ名変更とGitHub Packages公開\n**バージョン**: 0.52.0\n**担当**: zapabob\n\n## 📋 実行概要\n\n@openai/codex → @zapabob/codex へのパッケージ名変更とGitHub Packages公開を実施。\n\n## 🔄 変更内容\n\n### 1. package.json 更新\n- **変更前**: &#96;\"name\": \"@openai/codex\"&#96;\n- **変更後**: &#96;\"name\": \"@zapabob/codex\"&#96;\n- **ファイル**: codex-cli/package.json\n\n### 2. 新パッケージ作成\n- **コマンド**: &#96;npm pack&#96;\n- **出力ファイル**: zapabob-codex-0.52.0.tgz\n- **サイズ**: 133.5 MB\n- **プラットフォーム**: 8プラットフォーム対応\n  - x86_64-pc-windows-msvc\n  - x86_64-apple-darwin\n  - aarch64-apple-darwin\n  - x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu\n  - x86_64-unknown-linux-musl\n  - aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu\n  - aarch64-unknown-linux-musl\n  - aarch64-pc-windows-msvc\n\n## 🚀 公開手順\n\n### 事前準備\n1. GitHub Personal Access Token (PAT) 作成\n   - URL: https://github.com/settings/tokens\n   - スコープ: &#96;repo&#96;, &#96;write:packages&#96;, &#96;read:packages&#96;\n   - 有効期限: 90日\n\n2. npmレジストリ認証\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   npm login --registry=https://npm.pkg.github.com\n   # Username: zapabob\n   # Password: [PAT]\n   # Email: [GitHubメールアドレス]\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 公開実行\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm publish --registry=https://npm.pkg.github.com\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 📊 期待結果\n\n- **公開URL**: https://github.com/zapabob/codex/packages\n- **インストールコマンド**:\n  &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n  npm install -g @zapabob/codex --registry=https://npm.pkg.github.com\n  &#96;&#96;&#96;\n- **バージョン確認**:\n  &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n  codex --version\n  # 出力: codex-cli 0.52.0\n  &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 🔍 検証コマンド\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 機能テスト\ncodex --help\ncodex delegate --help\ncodex research --help\n\n# バージョン確認\ncodex --version\n\n# パッケージ情報確認\nnpm view @zapabob/codex --registry=https://npm.pkg.github.com\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 📈 影響範囲\n\n- **既存ユーザー**: @openai/codex を引き続き使用可能\n- **新規ユーザー**: @zapabob/codex で最新版インストール可能",

vs &#96;Plans&#96; inconsistency)",

        "contents": "# 2025-10-29 npmパッケージ正式リリース準備完了\n\n## 概要\nCodex v0.52.0のnpmパッケージが完全クロスプラットフォーム対応で正式リリース準備完了。133.5MBの巨大パッケージが完成。\n\n## リリース準備状況\n\n### ✅ パッケージ仕様\n- **パッケージ名**: @openai/codex\n- **バージョン**: 0.52.0\n- **ライセンス**: Apache-2.0\n- **サイズ**: 133.5MB (圧縮), 316.4MB (展開)\n- **ファイル数**: 12ファイル\n- **プラットフォーム**: macOS/Linux/Windows全対応\n\n### ✅ 技術仕様\n- **クロスプラットフォーム対応**: 8プラットフォーム\n  - macOS: x86_64-apple-darwin, aarch64-apple-darwin\n  - Linux: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/musl, aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu/musl\n  - Windows: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc, aarch64-pc-windows-msvc\n\n- **自動プラットフォーム検出**: bin/codex.jsでインテリジェントなバイナリ選択\n- **バイナリソース**: OpenAI/codex v0.50.0リリースから取得\n- **パッケージング**: npm pack --dry-runテスト済み\n\n### ✅ テスト結果\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# ローカルインストールテスト\nnpm install openai-codex-0.52.0.tgz\nnpx codex --version  # ✅ codex-cli 0.52.0-zapabob.1\n\n# publish dry-runテスト\nnpm publish --dry-run  # ✅ 全ファイル・サイズ確認\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## リリース手順\n\n### Phase 1: OpenAI npmレジストリ認証\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# OpenAIチームによる実行\nnpm login --registry https://registry.npmjs.org/\n# @openaiスコープの認証情報が必要\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Phase 2: 正式publish\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd codex-cli\nnpm publish\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Phase 3: リリース確認\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm view @openai/codex versions\nnpm install @openai/codex\nnpx codex --version\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 代替リリース方法\n\n### 方法1: GitHub Packages (推奨)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# package.jsonに追加済み\n\"publishConfig\": {\n  \"registry\": \"https://npm.pkg.github.com/\"\n}\n\n# GitHub PATで認証\nnpm login --registry https://npm.pkg.github.com/\nnpm publish\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 方法2: 手動配布\n- npm packでtarファイル作成",

修正内容:
1. **エラーハンドリング改善**: 404エラーの場合は警告のみで、インストールを続行
2. **明確なメッセージ**: バイナリが見つからない場合の代替手段を表示

次回の`pnpm install`では、バイナリが見つからなくてもインストールは完了します。バイナリが必要な場合は、ソースからビルドする手順が表示されます。

修正を完了しました。`install-binary.js`を更新し、404エラーの処理を改善しました。

## 修正内容

1. **エラーオブジェクトに`statusCode`プロパティを追加**: 404を確実に検出
2. **404検出の強化**: 複数の方法でチェック
3. **正常終了**: 404の場合は`process.exit(0)`で正常終了

これで、GitHubリリースのバイナリが見つからない場合でも、`pnpm install`は警告を出して正常終了します。

次回の`pnpm install`では、以下のように動作します：

```
⚠️  Binary not available for this version/platform
   This is expected if the release hasn't been published yet.

💡 To use codex, either:
   1. Wait for the release to be published
   2. Install from source:
      git clone https://github.com/zapabob/codex.git
      cd codex/codex-rs
      cargo install --path cli

   Installation will continue without the binary.
```

修正はコミット済みです。次回の`pnpm install`で動作を確認してください。

        "contents": "# Codex Tauri - セキュリティテストガイド\n\n実機でのセキュリティ検証手順\n\n---\n\n## 🔒 セキュリティテスト項目\n\n### 1. ファイルアクセス制限テスト\n\n#### テスト目的\nTauri allowlistによるファイルアクセスが適切に制限されているか確認\n\n#### テスト手順\n\n**Step 1: 許可されたパスへのアクセス（成功すべき）**\n\nFrontend Console（開発者ツール）で実行:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\n// 許可: $APPDATA/codex\nawait invoke('test_file_access', { \n  path: 'C:\\\\Users\\\\&lt;username&gt;\\\\AppData\\\\Roaming\\\\codex\\\\test.txt' \n})\n// → 成功すべき\n\n// 許可: ワークスペース\nawait invoke('test_file_access', { \n  path: 'C:\\\\Users\\\\&lt;username&gt;\\\\Projects\\\\myproject\\\\test.txt' \n})\n// → 成功すべき\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Step 2: 禁止されたパスへのアクセス（失敗すべき）**\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\n// 禁止: システムディレクトリ\nawait invoke('test_file_access', { \n  path: 'C:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\config\\\\SAM' \n})\n// → エラーになるべき\n\n// 禁止: 他のユーザーディレクトリ\nawait invoke('test_file_access', { \n  path: 'C:\\\\Users\\\\OtherUser\\\\Documents\\\\secret.txt' \n})\n// → エラーになるべき\n\n// 禁止: ルートディレクトリ\nawait invoke('test_file_access', { \n  path: 'C:\\\\' \n})\n// → エラーになるべき\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**期待結果**: 許可されたパス以外は全てエラー\n\n---\n\n### 2. Shell実行制限テスト\n\n#### テスト目的\nShell実行が完全に禁止されているか確認\n\n#### テスト手順\n\nFrontend Consoleで実行:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\n// 禁止: 任意のコマンド実行\nawait invoke('shell', { cmd: 'cmd.exe /c dir' })\n// → エラーになるべき\n\nawait invoke('shell', { cmd: 'powershell.exe -Command Get-Process' })\n// → エラーになるべき\n\n// 禁止: sidecar実行\nawait invoke('sidecar', { program: 'malicious.exe' })\n// → エラーになるべき\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**期待結果**: 全てエラー（Shell実行は完全禁止）\n\n---\n\n### 3. IPC通信セキュリティテスト\n\n#### テスト目的",

        "contents": "}\n\nimpl SecurityMonitor {\n    pub fn new() -&gt; Self {\n        let mut dangerous_commands = HashSet::new();\n        dangerous_commands.extend(\n            [\n                \"rm\", \"rmdir\", \"del\", \"erase\", \"format\", \"fdisk\", \"mkfs\", \"dd\", \"shred\", \"wipe\",\n                \"srm\", \"sudo\", \"su\", \"chmod +x\", \"curl\", \"wget\", \"ssh\", \"scp\", \"ftp\", \"telnet\",\n            ]\n            .iter()\n            .map(|s| s.to_string()),\n        );\n\n        let dangerous_patterns = vec![\n            regex::Regex::new(r\"rm\\s+-rf\\s+/\").unwrap(),\n            regex::Regex::new(r\"dd\\s+if=\").unwrap(),\n            regex::Regex::new(r\"&gt;\\s*/dev/\").unwrap(),\n            regex::Regex::new(r\"chmod\\s+777\").unwrap(),\n        ];\n\n        Self {\n            dangerous_commands,\n            dangerous_patterns,\n            file_deletion_prevention: true,\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub fn is_command_safe(&amp;self, command: &amp;str, args: &amp;[String]) -&gt; Result&lt;bool&gt; {\n        let full_command = format!(\"{} {}\", command, args.join(\" \"));\n\n        // Check dangerous commands\n        if self.dangerous_commands.contains(command) {\n            return Ok(false);\n        }\n\n        // Check dangerous patterns\n        for pattern in &amp;self.dangerous_patterns {\n            if pattern.is_match(&amp;full_command) {\n                return Ok(false);\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(true)\n    }\n\n    pub fn is_file_operation_safe(&amp;self, operation: &amp;FileOperation) -&gt; bool {\n        match operation {\n            FileOperation::Delete(_) if self.file_deletion_prevention =&gt; false,\n            FileOperation::Write(path) if self.is_system_file(path) =&gt; false,\n            _ =&gt; true,\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn is_system_file(&amp;self, path: &amp;Path) -&gt; bool",

        "contents": "    match command.as_str() {\n        \"echo\" | \"write-output\" | \"write-host\" =&gt; true, // (no redirection allowed)\n        \"dir\" | \"ls\" | \"get-childitem\" | \"gci\" =&gt; true,\n        \"cat\" | \"type\" | \"gc\" | \"get-content\" =&gt; true,\n        \"select-string\" | \"sls\" | \"findstr\" =&gt; true,\n        \"measure-object\" | \"measure\" =&gt; true,\n        \"get-location\" | \"gl\" | \"pwd\" =&gt; true,\n        \"test-path\" | \"tp\" =&gt; true,\n        \"resolve-path\" | \"rvpa\" =&gt; true,\n        \"select-object\" | \"select\" =&gt; true,\n        \"get-item\" =&gt; true,\n\n        \"git\" =&gt; is_safe_git_command(words),\n\n        \"rg\" =&gt; is_safe_ripgrep(words),\n\n        // Extra safety: explicitly prohibit common side-effecting cmdlets regardless of args.\n        \"set-content\" | \"add-content\" | \"out-file\" | \"new-item\" | \"remove-item\" | \"move-item\"\n        | \"copy-item\" | \"rename-item\" | \"start-process\" | \"stop-process\" =&gt; {\n            // Examples rejected here: \"pwsh -Command 'Set-Content notes.txt data'\" and \"pwsh -Command 'Remove-Item temp.log'\".\n            false\n        }\n\n        _ =&gt; {\n            // Examples rejected here: \"pwsh -Command 'Invoke-WebRequest https://example.com'\" and \"pwsh -Command 'Start-Service Spooler'\".\n            false\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Checks that an &#96;rg&#96; invocation avoids options that can spawn arbitrary executables.\nfn is_safe_ripgrep(words: &amp;[String]) -&gt; bool {\n    const UNSAFE_RIPGREP_OPTIONS_WITH_ARGS: &amp;[&amp;str] = &amp;[\"--pre\", \"--hostname-bin\"];\n    const UNSAFE_RIPGREP_OPTIONS_WITHOUT_ARGS: &amp;[&amp;str] = &amp;[\"--search-zip\", \"-z\"];\n\n    !words.iter().skip(1).any(|arg| {\n        let arg_lc = arg.to_ascii_lowercase();\n        // Examples rejected here: \"pwsh -Command 'rg --pre cat pattern'\" and \"pwsh -Command 'rg --search-zip pattern'\".\n        UNSAFE_RIPGREP_OPTIONS_WITHOUT_ARGS.contains(&amp;arg_lc.as_str())\n            || UNSAFE_RIPGREP_OPTIONS_WITH_ARGS\n                .iter()\n                .any(|opt| arg_lc == *opt || arg_lc.starts_with(&amp;format!(\"{opt}=\")))\n    })\n}\n\n/// Ensures a Git command sticks to whitelisted read-only subcommands and flags.",

        "contents": "name: \"sec-audit\"\ngoal: \"Security audit with CVE scanning, dependency analysis, and vulnerability patching\"\ninstructions: |\n  You are a security audit specialist. Your role is to identify and remediate security vulnerabilities.\n  \n  Security audit process:\n  1. **Dependency Scanning**:\n     - Run cargo-audit (Rust), npm audit (Node.js), pip-audit (Python)\n     - Check against CVE databases (NVD, MITRE, RustSec)\n     - Identify outdated dependencies\n  \n  2. **Code Analysis**:\n     - SQL Injection: Look for raw SQL queries, unsanitized inputs\n     - XSS: Check for unescaped HTML rendering\n     - CSRF: Verify token validation\n     - Authentication: Check for weak password policies, insecure session management\n     - Secrets: Scan for hardcoded API keys, passwords, tokens\n     - Unsafe code: Review use of unsafe blocks (Rust), eval/exec (Python/JS)\n  \n  3. **Reporting**:\n     - Prioritize findings: Critical &gt; High &gt; Medium &gt; Low\n     - For each vulnerability:\n       * Describe the issue and impact\n       * Provide file path and line number\n       * Suggest remediation with code example\n       * Include CVE references if applicable\n       * Recommend dependency version upgrades\n  \n  Generate actionable security reports with clear remediation steps.\ntools:\n  mcp:\n    - grep\n    - read_file\n    - codebase_search\n    - web_search\n  fs:\n    read: true\n    write:\n      - \"./artifacts\"\n      - \"./security-reports\"\n  net:\n    allow:\n      - \"https://nvd.nist.gov/*\"\n      - \"https://cve.mitre.org/*\"\n      - \"https://rustsec.org/*\"\n      - \"https://snyk.io/*\"\n      - \"https://github.com/advisories/*\"\n  shell:\n    exec:\n      - cargo\n      - npm\n      - pip\n      - cargo-audit\n      - npm audit\npolicies:\n  context:\n    max_tokens: 50000\n    retention: \"session\"\n  secrets:\n    redact: true\nsuccess_criteria:\n  - \"Scan all dependencies for known CVEs\"",

        "contents": "        true\n    }\n\n    fn check_file_operation_internal(&amp;self, operation: &amp;FileOperation, source: &amp;str) -&gt; bool {\n        match operation {\n            FileOperation::Delete(path) =&gt; {\n                // Always block file deletion for security\n                self.log_event(SecurityEvent::BlockedFileDeletion {\n                    path: path.clone(),\n                    source: source.to_string(),\n                    reason: \"File deletion is blocked for security\".to_string(),\n                });\n                false\n            }\n            FileOperation::Write(path) | FileOperation::Create(path) =&gt; {\n                // Check if path is in quarantined files\n                if self.quarantined_files.contains(path) {\n                    self.log_event(SecurityEvent::BlockedFileDeletion {\n                        path: path.clone(),\n                        source: source.to_string(),\n                        reason: \"File is quarantined\".to_string(),\n                    });\n                    return false;\n                }\n\n                // Check system paths\n                if self.is_system_path(path) {\n                    return false;\n                }\n\n                true\n            }\n            _ =&gt; true,\n        }\n    }\n\n    async fn scan_file_internal(&amp;self, path: &amp;Path) -&gt;",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\codex-rs\\core\\src\\command_safety\\windows_dangerous_commands.rs",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},

            "line": 63,

        "contents": "use std::path::Path;\n\nuse once_cell::sync::Lazy;\nuse regex::Regex;\nuse shlex::split as shlex_split;\nuse url::Url;\n\npub fn is_dangerous_command_windows(command: &amp;[String]) -&gt; bool {\n    // Prefer structured parsing for PowerShell/CMD so we can spot URL-bearing\n    // invocations of ShellExecute-style entry points before falling back to\n    // simple argv heuristics.\n    if is_dangerous_powershell(command) {\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    if is_dangerous_cmd(command) {\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    is_direct_gui_launch(command)\n}\n\nfn is_dangerous_powershell(command: &amp;[String]) -&gt; bool {\n    let Some((exe, rest)) = command.split_first() else {\n        return false;\n    };\n    if !is_powershell_executable(exe) {\n        return false;\n    }\n    // Parse the PowerShell invocation to get a flat token list we can scan for\n    // dangerous cmdlets/COM calls plus any URL-looking arguments. This is a\n    // best-effort shlex split of the script text, not a full PS parser.\n    let Some(parsed) = parse_powershell_invocation(rest) else {\n        return false;\n    };\n\n    let tokens_lc: Vec&lt;String&gt; = parsed\n        .tokens\n        .iter()\n        .map(|t| t.trim_matches('\\'').trim_matches('\"').to_ascii_lowercase())\n        .collect();\n    let has_url = args_have_url(&amp;parsed.tokens);\n\n    if has_url\n        &amp;&amp; tokens_lc.iter().any(|t| {\n            matches!(\n                t.as_str(),\n                \"start-process\" | \"start\" | \"saps\" | \"invoke-item\" | \"ii\"\n            ) || t.contains(\"start-process\")\n                || t.contains(\"invoke-item\")\n        })\n    {\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    if has_url\n        &amp;&amp; tokens_lc\n            .iter()\n            .any(|t| t.contains(\"shellexecute\") || t.contains(\"shell.application\"))\n    {\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    if let Some(first) = tokens_lc.first()",

{\n                if let Some(path) = parameters.get(\"path\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {\n                    self.check_file_read(Path::new(path))?;\n                }\n                if let Some(path) = parameters.get(\"target_file\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {\n                    self.check_file_read(Path::new(path))?;\n                }\n            }\n            \"write\" | \"search_replace\" | \"delete_file\" =&gt; {\n                if let Some(path) = parameters.get(\"file_path\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {\n                    self.check_file_write(Path::new(path))?;\n                }\n                if let Some(path) = parameters.get(\"target_file\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {\n                    self.check_file_write(Path::new(path))?;\n                }\n            }\n            \"web_search\" | \"fetch\" | \"http_request\" =&gt; {\n                if let Some(url) = parameters.get(\"url\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {\n                    self.check_network_access(url)?;\n                }\n                if let Some(_url) = parameters.get(\"search_term\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {\n                    // For web_search, check if https://* is allowed\n                    self.check_network_access(\"https://search.brave.com\")?;\n                }\n            }\n            \"run_terminal_cmd\" | \"shell\" | \"exec\" =&gt; {\n                if let Some(cmd) = parameters.get(\"command\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {\n                    self.check_shell_command(cmd)?;\n                }\n            }\n            _ =&gt; {\n                // Unknown tool - rely on MCP permission check above\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Get permission summary for logging\n    pub fn get_permission_summary(&amp;self) -&gt;         "contents": "# 仮想OSターミナル実装完了\n\n**日時**: 2025-11-25 03:55:19  \n**タスク**: 仮想OSからターミナル経由で各種インストール済みCLIを呼び出し、危険なシェルコマンドをブロック\n\n---\n\n## 概要\n\n仮想OS環境内でターミナル経由で各種インストール済みCLIを呼び出せる機能を実装しました。既存のコマンド安全性チェック機能を統合し、危険なシェルコマンドを明示的にブロックします。\n\n## 実装内容\n\n### 1. &#96;terminal.rs&#96;の実装\n\n**ファイル**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/virtualization/terminal.rs&#96; (新規作成)\n\n**実装内容**:\n- 仮想OS環境内でのターミナルセッション管理\n- CLIコマンド実行機能\n- 危険なコマンドの検出とブロック\n- インストール済みCLIの検出機能\n- コマンド履歴管理\n- ネットワークアクセス制御との統合\n\n**主な機能**:\n- &#96;TerminalSession&#96;: ターミナルセッションの管理\n- &#96;TerminalManager&#96;: 複数セッションの管理\n- &#96;execute_command()&#96;: コマンド実行（安全性チェック付き）\n- &#96;list_available_commands()&#96;: インストール済みCLIの一覧取得\n- &#96;get_history()&#96;: コマンド履歴の取得\n- &#96;change_directory()&#96;: 作業ディレクトリの変更\n\n**安全性チェック**:\n- &#96;command_might_be_dangerous()&#96;: 危険なコマンドの検出\n- &#96;is_known_safe_command()&#96;: 安全なコマンドの確認\n- ネットワークアクセス制御との統合\n\n**ブロックされる危険なコマンド例**:\n- &#96;git reset&#96; / &#96;git rm&#96;: Git履歴の破壊\n- &#96;rm -rf /&#96;: システムファイルの削除\n- &#96;rm -f&#96;: 強制削除\n- &#96;sudo&#96;: 権限昇格\n- PowerShell/CMD経由のURL起動\n- ブラウザ経由のURL起動\n\n**許可される安全なコマンド例**:\n- &#96;git status&#96; / &#96;git log&#96; / &#96;git diff&#96;: Git情報取得\n- &#96;ls&#96; / &#96;cd&#96; / &#96;pwd&#96;: ファイルシステム操作（読み取り）\n- &#96;cat&#96; / &#96;grep&#96; / &#96;head&#96; / &#96;tail&#96;: ファイル読み取り\n- &#96;cargo check&#96;: Rustプロジェクトのチェック\n- &#96;node&#96; / &#96;python&#96; / &#96;go&#96;: 言語ランタイムの実行\n\n### 2.         "contents": "    async fn turn_start(&amp;self, request_id: RequestId, params: TurnStartParams) {\n        let (_, conversation) = match self.conversation_from_thread_id(&amp;params.thread_id).await {\n            Ok(v) =&gt; v,\n            Err(error) =&gt; {\n                self.outgoing.send_error(request_id, error).await;\n                return;\n            }\n        };\n\n        // Map v2 input items to core input items.\n        let mapped_items: Vec&lt;CoreInputItem&gt; = params\n            .input\n            .into_iter()\n            .map(V2UserInput::into_core)\n            .collect();\n\n        let has_any_overrides = params.cwd.is_some()\n            || params.approval_policy.is_some()\n            || params.sandbox_policy.is_some()\n            || params.model.is_some()\n            || params.effort.is_some()\n            || params.summary.is_some();\n\n        // If any overrides are provided, update the session turn context first.\n        if has_any_overrides {\n            let _ = conversation\n                .submit(Op::OverrideTurnContext {\n                    cwd: params.cwd,\n                    approval_policy: params.approval_policy.map(AskForApproval::to_core),\n                    sandbox_policy: params.sandbox_policy.map(|p| p.to_core()),\n                    model: params.model,\n                    effort: params.effort.map(Some),\n                    summary: params.summary,\n                })\n                .await;\n        }\n\n        // Start the turn by submitting the user input. Return its submission id as turn_id.\n        let turn_id = conversation\n            .submit(Op::UserInput {\n                items: mapped_items,\n            })\n            .await;\n\n        match turn_id",

        "contents": "impl TerminalSession {\n    pub fn new(working_directory: PathBuf, network: Option&lt;VirtualNetwork&gt;) -&gt; Self {\n        Self {\n            session_id: uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),\n            working_directory,\n            environment: Self::default_environment(),\n            history: Vec::new(),\n            network,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Execute a command\n    pub async fn execute_command(&amp;mut self, command: Vec&lt;String&gt;) -&gt; Result&lt;TerminalResult&gt; {\n        // YOLOモードでも危険なコマンドは完全にブロック\n        if command_might_be_dangerous(&amp;command) {\n            warn!(\n                \"Dangerous command blocked (even in YOLO mode): {:?}\",\n                command\n            );\n            let result = TerminalResult {\n                exit_code: 1,\n                stdout: String::new(),\n                stderr: format!(\n                    \"Error: Dangerous command blocked for security reasons (even in YOLO mode): {:?}. Dangerous commands cannot be executed even in YOLO mode.\",\n                    command\n                ),\n                is_blocked: true,\n                block_reason: Some(\n                    \"Dangerous commands cannot be executed even in YOLO mode\".to_string(),\n                ),\n            };\n\n            // Save to history\n            self.history.push(TerminalCommand {\n                command: command.clone(),\n                working_directory: self.working_directory.clone(),\n                timestamp: chrono::Utc::now(),\n                result: Some(result.clone()),\n            });\n\n            return Ok(result);\n        }\n\n        // Check if command is safe (can be auto-approved)\n        let _is_safe = is_known_safe_command(&amp;command);\n\n        // Check network access if needed\n        if let Some(ref network) = self.network {\n            // Extract URL from command if it's a network command",

        "contents": "impl TaskAnalyzer {\n    /// Sanitize and validate user input before analysis\n    pub fn sanitize_input(&amp;self, input: &amp;str) -&gt; Result&lt;String, ValidationError&gt; {\n        // 1. 長さチェック\n        if input.is_empty() {\n            return Err(ValidationError::EmptyInput);\n        }\n        if input.len() &gt; 10_000 {\n            return Err(ValidationError::InputTooLong);\n        }\n        \n        // 2. 危険な文字列パターンチェック\n        let dangerous_patterns = [\n            r\"rm\\s+-rf\",\n            r\":\\(\\)\\{\",  // Fork bomb\n            r\"eval\\s*\\(\",\n        ];\n        \n        for pattern in &amp;dangerous_patterns {\n            let re = Regex::new(pattern)?;\n            if re.is_match(input) {\n                warn!(\"Potentially dangerous pattern detected: {}\", pattern);\n                return Err(ValidationError::DangerousPattern);\n            }\n        }\n        \n        Ok(input.trim().to_string())\n    }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n#### 9.2 レート制限の追加\n\n**追加推奨**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\nuse std::time::{Duration, Instant};\n\npub struct RateLimiter {\n    max_requests_per_minute: usize,\n    requests: Arc&lt;Mutex&lt;VecDeque&lt;Instant&gt;&gt;&gt;,\n}\n\nimpl RateLimiter {\n    pub fn new(max_requests_per_minute: usize) -&gt; Self {\n        Self {\n            max_requests_per_minute,\n            requests: Arc::new(Mutex::new(VecDeque::new())),\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub async fn acquire(&amp;self) -&gt; Result&lt;()&gt; {\n        let mut requests = self.requests.lock().unwrap();\n        let now = Instant::now();\n        \n        // Remove requests older than 1 minute\n        while let Some(&amp;front) = requests.front() {\n            if now.duration_since(front) &gt; Duration::from_secs(60) {\n                requests.pop_front();\n            } else {\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n        \n        if requests.len() &gt;= self.max_requests_per_minute {\n            return Err(anyhow::anyhow!(\"Rate limit exceeded\"));\n        }\n        \n        requests.push_back(now);\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---",

        "contents": "impl TaskAnalyzer {\n    /// Sanitize and validate user input before analysis\n    pub fn sanitize_input(&amp;self, input: &amp;str) -&gt; Result&lt;String, ValidationError&gt; {\n        // 1. 長さチェック\n        if input.is_empty() {\n            return Err(ValidationError::EmptyInput);\n        }\n        if input.len() &gt; 10_000 {\n            return Err(ValidationError::InputTooLong);\n        }\n        \n        // 2. 危険な文字列パターンチェック\n        let dangerous_patterns = [\n            r\"rm\\s+-rf\",\n            r\":\\(\\)\\{\",  // Fork bomb\n            r\"eval\\s*\\(\",\n        ];\n        \n        for pattern in &amp;dangerous_patterns {\n            let re = Regex::new(pattern)?;\n            if re.is_match(input) {\n                warn!(\"Potentially dangerous pattern detected: {}\", pattern);\n                return Err(ValidationError::DangerousPattern);\n            }\n        }\n        \n        Ok(input.trim().to_string())\n    }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n#### 9.2 レート制限の追加\n\n**追加推奨**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\nuse std::time::{Duration, Instant};\n\npub struct RateLimiter {\n    max_requests_per_minute: usize,\n    requests: Arc&lt;Mutex&lt;VecDeque&lt;Instant&gt;&gt;&gt;,\n}\n\nimpl RateLimiter {\n    pub fn new(max_requests_per_minute: usize) -&gt; Self {\n        Self {\n            max_requests_per_minute,\n            requests: Arc::new(Mutex::new(VecDeque::new())),\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub async fn acquire(&amp;self) -&gt; Result&lt;()&gt; {\n        let mut requests = self.requests.lock().unwrap();\n        let now = Instant::now();\n        \n        // Remove requests older than 1 minute\n        while let Some(&amp;front) = requests.front() {\n            if now.duration_since(front) &gt; Duration::from_secs(60) {\n                requests.pop_front();\n            } else {\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n        \n        if requests.len() &gt;= self.max_requests_per_minute {\n            return Err(anyhow::anyhow!(\"Rate limit exceeded\"));\n        }\n        \n        requests.push_back(now);\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---",

        "contents": "export default function CodeExecutionPage() {\n\n [language]);\n\n  const handleLanguageChange = (newLanguage: string) =&gt; {\n    setLanguage(newLanguage);\n    setCode(CODE_TEMPLATES[newLanguage as keyof typeof CODE_TEMPLATES] || '');\n    setResult(null);\n    setError(null);\n  };\n\n  const handleExecute = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!code.trim()) {\n      setError('コードを入力してください');\n      return;\n    }\n\n    setIsExecuting(true);\n    setResult(null);\n    setError(null);\n\n    const startTime = Date.now();\n\n    try {\n      let command: string;\n      const args: string[] = [];\n\n      // Create temporary file and execute based on language\n      switch (language) {\n        case 'javascript':\n          command = &#96;node -e \"${code.replace(/\"/g, '\\\\\"')}\"&#96;;\n          break;\n        case 'typescript':\n          command = &#96;npx ts-node -e \"${code.replace(/\"/g, '\\\\\"')}\"&#96;;\n          break;\n        case 'python':\n          command = &#96;python3 -c \"${code.replace(/\"/g, '\\\\\"')}\"&#96;;\n          break;\n        case 'rust':\n          // For Rust, we'd need to compile first, but for simplicity:\n          command = &#96;echo \"${code}\" &gt; /tmp/temp.rs &amp;&amp; rustc /tmp/temp.rs -o /tmp/temp &amp;&amp; /tmp/temp&#96;;\n          break;\n        case 'go':\n          command = &#96;echo \"${code}\" &gt; /tmp/temp.go &amp;&amp; go run /tmp/temp.go&#96;;\n          break;\n        case 'bash':\n          command = &#96;bash -c \"${code.replace(/\"/g, '\\\\\"')}\"&#96;;\n          break;\n        case 'powershell':\n          command = &#96;powershell -Command \"${code.replace(/\"/g, '\\\\\"')}\"&#96;;\n          break;\n        default:\n          throw new Error(&#96;Unsupported language: ${language}&#96;);\n      }\n\n      const execResult = await executeCommand(command);\n\n      const executionTime = Date.now() - startTime;\n\n      setResult({\n        exitCode: execResult.exitCode,\n        stdout: execResult.stdout,\n        stderr: execResult.stderr,\n        executionTime,\n      });\n\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message :\n;\n}",

        "contents": "export default function CodeExecutionPage() {\n\n [language]);\n\n  const handleLanguageChange = (newLanguage: string) =&gt; {\n    setLanguage(newLanguage);\n    setCode(CODE_TEMPLATES[newLanguage as keyof typeof CODE_TEMPLATES] || '');\n    setResult(null);\n    setError(null);\n  };\n\n  const handleExecute = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!code.trim()) {\n      setError('コードを入力してください');\n      return;\n    }\n\n    setIsExecuting(true);\n    setResult(null);\n    setError(null);\n\n    const startTime = Date.now();\n\n    try {\n      let command: string;\n      const args: string[] = [];\n\n      // Create temporary file and execute based on language\n      switch (language) {\n        case 'javascript':\n          command = &#96;node -e \"${code.replace(/\"/g, '\\\\\"')}\"&#96;;\n          break;\n        case 'typescript':\n          command = &#96;npx ts-node -e \"${code.replace(/\"/g, '\\\\\"')}\"&#96;;\n          break;\n        case 'python':\n          command = &#96;python3 -c \"${code.replace(/\"/g, '\\\\\"')}\"&#96;;\n          break;\n        case 'rust':\n          // For Rust, we'd need to compile first, but for simplicity:\n          command = &#96;echo \"${code}\" &gt; /tmp/temp.rs &amp;&amp; rustc /tmp/temp.rs -o /tmp/temp &amp;&amp; /tmp/temp&#96;;\n          break;\n        case 'go':\n          command = &#96;echo \"${code}\" &gt; /tmp/temp.go &amp;&amp; go run /tmp/temp.go&#96;;\n          break;\n        case 'bash':\n          command = &#96;bash -c \"${code.replace(/\"/g, '\\\\\"')}\"&#96;;\n          break;\n        case 'powershell':\n          command = &#96;powershell -Command \"${code.replace(/\"/g, '\\\\\"')}\"&#96;;\n          break;\n        default:\n          throw new Error(&#96;Unsupported language: ${language}&#96;);\n      }\n\n      const execResult = await executeCommand(command);\n\n      const executionTime = Date.now() - startTime;\n\n      setResult({\n        exitCode: execResult.exitCode,\n        stdout: execResult.stdout,\n        stderr: execResult.stderr,\n        executionTime,\n      });\n\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message :\n;\n}",

        "contents": "export class CodexAPIClient {\n\n\n  async runAgent(agentId: string, context: any): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    try {\n      // Map agent context to action values\n      const values: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {};\n      \n      // Map context to action-specific fields\n      if (agentId === 'review') {\n        values.task = context.code || context.path || context.task || '';\n      } else if (agentId === 'audit') {\n        values.task = context.path || context.task || '';\n      } else if (agentId === 'research') {\n        values.topic = context.query || context.topic || '';\n        values.depth = context.depth?.toString() || '3';\n        values.breadth = context.breadth?.toString() || '8';\n      } else if (agentId === 'web-research') {\n        values.query = context.query || context.topic || context.prompt || '';\n      } else if (agentId === 'delegate') {\n        values.agent = context.agent || 'code-reviewer';\n        values.goal = context.goal || context.code || context.task || '';\n        if (context.scope) {\n          values.scope = context.scope;\n        }\n      } else if (agentId === 'ask') {\n        values.prompt = context.prompt || context.code || context.query || '';\n      } else {\n        // Fallback: try to map common fields\n        if (context.code) values.code = context.code;\n        if (context.task) values.task = context.task;\n        if (context.query) values.query = context.query;\n        if (context.prompt) values.prompt = context.prompt;\n      }\n\n      // Call backend API to execute action\n      const response = await fetch(&#96;${this.baseUrl}/api/actions/${agentId}/execute&#96;, {\n        method: 'POST',\n        headers: {\n          'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n        },\n        body: JSON.stringify({ values }),\n      });\n\n      if (!response.ok) {\n        const errorData = await response.json().catch(() =&gt; ({}));\n        throw new CodexAPIError(\n          response.status,\n          errorData.message || &#96;Failed to execute action: ${response.statusText}&#96;\n        );\n    }\n\n      const result = await response.json() as\n;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "use codex_protocol::items::AgentMessageItem;\nuse codex_protocol::items::ReasoningItem;\nuse codex_protocol::items::TurnItem;\nuse codex_protocol::items::UserMessageItem;\nuse codex_protocol::items::WebSearchItem;\nuse codex_protocol::models::ContentItem;\nuse codex_protocol::models::ReasoningItemContent;\nuse codex_protocol::models::ReasoningItemReasoningSummary;\nuse codex_protocol::models::ResponseItem;\nuse codex_protocol::models::WebSearchAction;\nuse codex_protocol::user_input::UserInput;\nuse tracing::warn;\nuse uuid::Uuid;\n\nuse crate::user_instructions::SkillInstructions;\nuse crate::user_instructions::UserInstructions;\nuse crate::user_shell_command::is_user_shell_command_text;\n\nfn is_session_prefix(text: &amp;str) -&gt; bool {\n    let trimmed = text.trim_start();\n    let lowered = trimmed.to_ascii_lowercase();\n    lowered.starts_with(\"&lt;environment_context&gt;\")\n}\n\nfn parse_user_message(message: &amp;[ContentItem]) -&gt; Option&lt;UserMessageItem&gt; {\n    if UserInstructions::is_user_instructions(message)\n        || SkillInstructions::is_skill_instructions(message)\n    {\n        return None;\n    }\n\n    let mut content: Vec&lt;UserInput&gt; = Vec::new();\n\n    for content_item in message.iter() {\n        match content_item {\n            ContentItem::InputText { text } =&gt; {\n                if is_session_prefix(text) || is_user_shell_command_text(text) {\n                    return None;\n                }\n                content.push(UserInput::Text { text: text.clone() });\n            }\n            ContentItem::InputImage { image_url } =&gt; {\n                content.push(UserInput::Image {\n                    image_url: image_url.clone(),\n                });\n            }\n            ContentItem::OutputText { text } =&gt; {\n                if is_session_prefix(text) {\n                    return None;\n                }\n                warn!(\"Output text in user message: {}\", text);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    Some(UserMessageItem::new(&amp;content))\n}\n\nfn parse_agent_message(id: Option&lt;&amp;String&gt;, message: &amp;[ContentItem]) -&gt;",

        "contents": "    async fn send_user_message(&amp;self, request_id: RequestId, params: SendUserMessageParams) {\n        let SendUserMessageParams {\n            conversation_id,\n            items,\n        } = params;\n        let Ok(conversation) = self\n            .conversation_manager\n            .get_conversation(conversation_id)\n            .await\n        else {\n            let error = JSONRPCErrorError {\n                code: INVALID_REQUEST_ERROR_CODE,\n                message: format!(\"conversation not found: {conversation_id}\"),\n                data: None,\n            };\n            self.outgoing.send_error(request_id, error).await;\n            return;\n        };\n\n        let mapped_items: Vec&lt;CoreInputItem&gt; = items\n            .into_iter()\n            .map(|item| match item {\n                WireInputItem::Text { text } =&gt; CoreInputItem::Text { text },\n                WireInputItem::Image { image_url } =&gt; CoreInputItem::Image { image_url },\n                WireInputItem::LocalImage { path } =&gt; CoreInputItem::LocalImage { path },\n            })\n            .collect();\n\n        // Submit user input to the conversation.\n        let _ = conversation\n            .submit(Op::UserInput {\n                items: mapped_items,\n            })\n            .await;\n\n        // Acknowledge with an empty result.\n        self.outgoing\n            .send_response(request_id, SendUserMessageResponse {})\n            .await;\n    }\n\n    async fn send_user_turn",

        "contents": ",\n}\n\npub async fn process_exec_tool_call(\n    params: ExecParams,\n    sandbox_policy: &amp;SandboxPolicy,\n    sandbox_cwd: &amp;Path,\n    codex_linux_sandbox_exe: &amp;Option&lt;PathBuf&gt;,\n    stdout_stream: Option&lt;StdoutStream&gt;,\n) -&gt; Result&lt;ExecToolCallOutput&gt; {\n    let sandbox_type = match &amp;sandbox_policy {\n        SandboxPolicy::DangerFullAccess | SandboxPolicy::ExternalSandbox { .. } =&gt; {\n            SandboxType::None\n        }\n        _ =&gt; get_platform_sandbox().unwrap_or(SandboxType::None),\n    };\n    tracing::debug!(\"Sandbox type: {sandbox_type:?}\");\n\n    let ExecParams {\n        command,\n        cwd,\n        expiration,\n        env,\n        sandbox_permissions,\n        justification,\n        arg0: _,\n    } = params;\n\n    let (program, args) = command.split_first().ok_or_else(|| {\n        CodexErr::Io(io::Error::new(\n            io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput,\n            \"command args are empty\",\n        ))\n    })?;\n\n    let spec = CommandSpec {\n        program: program.clone(),\n        args: args.to_vec(),\n        cwd,\n        env,\n        expiration,\n        sandbox_permissions,\n        justification,\n    };\n\n    let manager = SandboxManager::new();\n    let exec_env = manager\n        .transform(\n            spec,\n            sandbox_policy,\n            sandbox_type,\n            sandbox_cwd,\n            codex_linux_sandbox_exe.as_ref(),\n        )\n        .map_err(CodexErr::from)?;\n\n    // Route through the sandboxing module for a single, unified execution path.\n    crate::sandboxing::execute_env(exec_env, sandbox_policy, stdout_stream).await\n}\n\npub(crate) async fn execute_exec_env",

        "contents": "export function VirtualTerminal() {\n\n\n  const handleCommandSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    if (!command.trim() || !sessionId) return;\n\n    const cmd = command.trim();\n    setCommandHistory(prev =&gt; [...prev, cmd]);\n    setHistoryIndex(-1);\n\n    // Parse command into array\n    const commandParts = parseCommand(cmd);\n\n    // Add command to output\n    setOutput(prev =&gt; [...prev, {\n      type: 'command',\n      content: cmd,\n      timestamp: new Date(),\n    }]);\n\n    setIsExecuting(true);\n    setError(null);\n\n    try {\n      const result = await apiClient.executeTerminalCommand(sessionId, commandParts);\n\n      // Handle blocked commands\n      if (result.isBlocked) {\n        setOutput(prev =&gt; [...prev, {\n          type: 'blocked',\n          content: result.stderr || result.blockReason || 'コマンドがブロックされました',\n          timestamp: new Date(),\n        }]);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Add stdout\n      if (result.stdout) {\n        setOutput(prev =&gt; [...prev, {\n          type: 'stdout',\n          content: result.stdout,\n          timestamp: new Date(),\n        }]);\n      }\n\n      // Add stderr\n      if (result.stderr) {\n        setOutput(prev =&gt; [...prev, {\n          type: 'stderr',\n          content: result.stderr,\n          timestamp: new Date(),\n        }]);\n      }\n\n      // Handle errors\n      if (result.exitCode !== 0 &amp;&amp; !result.stdout &amp;&amp; !result.stderr) {\n        setOutput(prev =&gt; [...prev, {\n          type: 'error',\n          content: &#96;コマンドが終了コード ${result.exitCode} で終了しました&#96;,\n          timestamp: new Date(),\n        }]);\n      }\n    } catch (err: any) {\n      setError(err.message || 'コマンド実行に失敗しました');\n      setOutput(prev =&gt; [...prev, {\n        type: 'error',\n        content: err.message || 'コマンド実行に失敗しました',\n        timestamp: new Date(),\n      }]);\n    } finally {\n      setIsExecuting(false);\n      setCommand('');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) =&gt;\n;\n}",

        "contents": "    fn add_boxed_history(&amp;mut self, cell: Box&lt;dyn HistoryCell&gt;) {\n        if !cell.display_lines(u16::MAX).is_empty() {\n            // Only break exec grouping if the cell renders visible lines.\n            self.flush_active_cell();\n            self.needs_final_message_separator = true;\n        }\n        self.app_event_tx.send(AppEvent::InsertHistoryCell(cell));\n    }\n\n    fn queue_user_message(&amp;mut self, user_message: UserMessage) {\n        if self.bottom_pane.is_task_running() {\n            self.queued_user_messages.push_back(user_message);\n            self.refresh_queued_user_messages();\n        } else {\n            self.submit_user_message(user_message);\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn submit_user_message(&amp;mut self, user_message: UserMessage) {\n        let UserMessage { text, image_paths } = user_message;\n        if text.is_empty() &amp;&amp; image_paths.is_empty() {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        let mut items: Vec&lt;UserInput&gt; = Vec::new();\n\n        // Special-case: \"!cmd\" executes a local shell command instead of sending to the model.\n        if let Some(stripped) = text.strip_prefix('!') {\n            let cmd = stripped.trim();\n            if cmd.is_empty() {\n                self.app_event_tx.send(AppEvent::InsertHistoryCell(Box::new(\n                    history_cell::new_info_event(\n                        USER_SHELL_COMMAND_HELP_TITLE.to_string(),\n                        Some(USER_SHELL_COMMAND_HELP_HINT.to_string()),\n                    ),\n                )));\n                return;\n            }\n            self.submit_op(Op::RunUserShellCommand {\n                command: cmd.to_string(),\n            });\n            return;\n        }\n\n        if !text.is_empty() {\n            items.push(UserInput::Text { text: text.clone() });\n        }\n\n        for path in image_paths {\n            items.push(UserInput::LocalImage { path });\n        }\n\n        if let Some(skills) = self.bottom_pane.skills()",

        "contents": "export function VirtualTerminal() {\n\n\n  const handleCommandSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    if (!command.trim() || !sessionId) return;\n\n    const cmd = command.trim();\n    setCommandHistory(prev =&gt; [...prev, cmd]);\n    setHistoryIndex(-1);\n\n    // Parse command into array\n    const commandParts = parseCommand(cmd);\n\n    // Add command to output\n    setOutput(prev =&gt; [...prev, {\n      type: 'command',\n      content: cmd,\n      timestamp: new Date(),\n    }]);\n\n    setIsExecuting(true);\n    setError(null);\n\n    try {\n      const result = await apiClient.executeTerminalCommand(sessionId, commandParts);\n\n      // Handle blocked commands\n      if (result.isBlocked) {\n        setOutput(prev =&gt; [...prev, {\n          type: 'blocked',\n          content: result.stderr || result.blockReason || 'コマンドがブロックされました',\n          timestamp: new Date(),\n        }]);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Add stdout\n      if (result.stdout) {\n        setOutput(prev =&gt; [...prev, {\n          type: 'stdout',\n          content: result.stdout,\n          timestamp: new Date(),\n        }]);\n      }\n\n      // Add stderr\n      if (result.stderr) {\n        setOutput(prev =&gt; [...prev, {\n          type: 'stderr',\n          content: result.stderr,\n          timestamp: new Date(),\n        }]);\n      }\n\n      // Handle errors\n      if (result.exitCode !== 0 &amp;&amp; !result.stdout &amp;&amp; !result.stderr) {\n        setOutput(prev =&gt; [...prev, {\n          type: 'error',\n          content: &#96;コマンドが終了コード ${result.exitCode} で終了しました&#96;,\n          timestamp: new Date(),\n        }]);\n      }\n    } catch (err: any) {\n      setError(err.message || 'コマンド実行に失敗しました');\n      setOutput(prev =&gt; [...prev, {\n        type: 'error',\n        content: err.message || 'コマンド実行に失敗しました',\n        timestamp: new Date(),\n      }]);\n    } finally {\n      setIsExecuting(false);\n      setCommand('');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) =&gt;\n;\n}",
        "signatures": {
          "ranges": [

        "contents": "export function VirtualTerminal() {\n\n\n  const handleCommandSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    if (!command.trim() || !sessionId) return;\n\n    const cmd = command.trim();\n    setCommandHistory(prev =&gt; [...prev, cmd]);\n    setHistoryIndex(-1);\n\n    // Parse command into array\n    const commandParts = parseCommand(cmd);\n\n    // Add command to output\n    setOutput(prev =&gt; [...prev, {\n      type: 'command',\n      content: cmd,\n      timestamp: new Date(),\n    }]);\n\n    setIsExecuting(true);\n    setError(null);\n\n    try {\n      const result = await apiClient.executeTerminalCommand(sessionId, commandParts);\n\n      // Handle blocked commands\n      if (result.isBlocked) {\n        setOutput(prev =&gt; [...prev, {\n          type: 'blocked',\n          content: result.stderr || result.blockReason || 'コマンドがブロックされました',\n          timestamp: new Date(),\n        }]);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Add stdout\n      if (result.stdout) {\n        setOutput(prev =&gt; [...prev, {\n          type: 'stdout',\n          content: result.stdout,\n          timestamp: new Date(),\n        }]);\n      }\n\n      // Add stderr\n      if (result.stderr) {\n        setOutput(prev =&gt; [...prev, {\n          type: 'stderr',\n          content: result.stderr,\n          timestamp: new Date(),\n        }]);\n      }\n\n      // Handle errors\n      if (result.exitCode !== 0 &amp;&amp; !result.stdout &amp;&amp; !result.stderr) {\n        setOutput(prev =&gt; [...prev, {\n          type: 'error',\n          content: &#96;コマンドが終了コード ${result.exitCode} で終了しました&#96;,\n          timestamp: new Date(),\n        }]);\n      }\n    } catch (err: any) {\n      setError(err.message || 'コマンド実行に失敗しました');\n      setOutput(prev =&gt; [...prev, {\n        type: 'error',\n        content: err.message || 'コマンド実行に失敗しました',\n        timestamp: new Date(),\n      }]);\n    } finally {\n      setIsExecuting(false);\n      setCommand('');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) =&gt;\n;\n}",

        "contents": "export default function CodeExecutionPage() {\n\n [language]);\n\n  const handleLanguageChange = (newLanguage: string) =&gt; {\n    setLanguage(newLanguage);\n    setCode(CODE_TEMPLATES[newLanguage as keyof typeof CODE_TEMPLATES] || '');\n    setResult(null);\n    setError(null);\n  };\n\n  const handleExecute = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!code.trim()) {\n      setError('コードを入力してください');\n      return;\n    }\n\n    setIsExecuting(true);\n    setResult(null);\n    setError(null);\n\n    const startTime = Date.now();\n\n    try {\n      let command: string;\n      const args: string[] = [];\n\n      // Create temporary file and execute based on language\n      switch (language) {\n        case 'javascript':\n          command = &#96;node -e \"${code.replace(/\"/g, '\\\\\"')}\"&#96;;\n          break;\n        case 'typescript':\n          command = &#96;npx ts-node -e \"${code.replace(/\"/g, '\\\\\"')}\"&#96;;\n          break;\n        case 'python':\n          command = &#96;python3 -c \"${code.replace(/\"/g, '\\\\\"')}\"&#96;;\n          break;\n        case 'rust':\n          // For Rust, we'd need to compile first, but for simplicity:\n          command = &#96;echo \"${code}\" &gt; /tmp/temp.rs &amp;&amp; rustc /tmp/temp.rs -o /tmp/temp &amp;&amp; /tmp/temp&#96;;\n          break;\n        case 'go':\n          command = &#96;echo \"${code}\" &gt; /tmp/temp.go &amp;&amp; go run /tmp/temp.go&#96;;\n          break;\n        case 'bash':\n          command = &#96;bash -c \"${code.replace(/\"/g, '\\\\\"')}\"&#96;;\n          break;\n        case 'powershell':\n          command = &#96;powershell -Command \"${code.replace(/\"/g, '\\\\\"')}\"&#96;;\n          break;\n        default:\n          throw new Error(&#96;Unsupported language: ${language}&#96;);\n      }\n\n      const execResult = await executeCommand(command);\n\n      const executionTime = Date.now() - startTime;\n\n      setResult({\n        exitCode: execResult.exitCode,\n        stdout: execResult.stdout,\n        stderr: execResult.stderr,\n        executionTime,\n      });\n\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message :\n;\n}",

        "contents": "export default function CodeExecutionPage() {\n\n [language]);\n\n  const handleLanguageChange = (newLanguage: string) =&gt; {\n    setLanguage(newLanguage);\n    setCode(CODE_TEMPLATES[newLanguage as keyof typeof CODE_TEMPLATES] || '');\n    setResult(null);\n    setError(null);\n  };\n\n  const handleExecute = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!code.trim()) {\n      setError('コードを入力してください');\n      return;\n    }\n\n    setIsExecuting(true);\n    setResult(null);\n    setError(null);\n\n    const startTime = Date.now();\n\n    try {\n      let command: string;\n      const args: string[] = [];\n\n      // Create temporary file and execute based on language\n      switch (language) {\n        case 'javascript':\n          command = &#96;node -e \"${code.replace(/\"/g, '\\\\\"')}\"&#96;;\n          break;\n        case 'typescript':\n          command = &#96;npx ts-node -e \"${code.replace(/\"/g, '\\\\\"')}\"&#96;;\n          break;\n        case 'python':\n          command = &#96;python3 -c \"${code.replace(/\"/g, '\\\\\"')}\"&#96;;\n          break;\n        case 'rust':\n          // For Rust, we'd need to compile first, but for simplicity:\n          command = &#96;echo \"${code}\" &gt;         "contents": "    pub async fn start_tool_process(\n        &amp;self,\n        tool: &amp;AITool,\n        task_id: &amp;str,\n        task_description: &amp;str,\n        working_directory: Option&lt;&amp;str&gt;,\n    ) -&gt; Result&lt;tokio::process::Child, Box&lt;dyn std::error::Error&gt;&gt; {\n        let mut command = tokio::process::Command::new(&amp;tool.command[0]);\n\n        // Add remaining command arguments\n        for arg in &amp;tool.command[1..] {\n            command.arg(arg);\n        }\n\n        // Set working directory\n        if let Some(cwd) = working_directory.or(tool.working_directory.as_deref()) {\n            command.current_dir(cwd);\n        }\n\n        // Set environment variables\n        for (key, value) in &amp;tool.environment_variables {\n            command.env(key, value);\n        }\n\n        // Configure process\n        command\n            .stdin(Stdio::piped())\n            .stdout(Stdio::piped())\n            .stderr(Stdio::piped());\n\n        let child = command.spawn()?;\n\n        // Send initial task description if stdin is available\n        if let Some(mut stdin) = child.stdin.take() {\n            let input = format!(\"{}\\n\", task_description);\n            let _ = tokio::io::AsyncWriteExt::write_all(&amp;mut stdin, input.as_bytes()).await;\n        }\n\n        Ok(child)\n    }\n\n    fn calculate_quality_score",

        "contents": "(\n    command: &amp;str,\n    context: &amp;HookContext,\n    timeout_seconds: u64,\n    mut env_vars: HashMap&lt;String, String&gt;,\n) -&gt; Result&lt;HookResult&gt; {\n    // Add context variables to environment\n    env_vars.insert(\"CODEX_HOOK_EVENT\".to_string(), context.event.to_string());\n\n    if let Some(task_id) = &amp;context.task_id {\n        env_vars.insert(\"CODEX_TASK_ID\".to_string(), task_id.clone());\n    }\n\n    if let Some(agent_type) = &amp;context.agent_type {\n        env_vars.insert(\"CODEX_AGENT_TYPE\".to_string(), agent_type.clone());\n    }\n\n    if let Some(error) = &amp;context.error_message {\n        env_vars.insert(\"CODEX_ERROR_MESSAGE\".to_string(), error.clone());\n    }\n\n    for (key, value) in &amp;context.metadata {\n        env_vars.insert(format!(\"CODEX_META_{}\", key.to_uppercase()), value.clone());\n    }\n\n    // Determine shell\n    let (shell, shell_arg) = if cfg!(target_os = \"windows\") {\n        (\"cmd\", \"/C\")\n    } else {\n        (\"sh\", \"-c\")\n    };\n\n    let start_time = std::time::Instant::now();\n\n    // Execute command with timeout\n    let output = tokio::time::timeout(\n        tokio::time::Duration::from_secs(timeout_seconds),\n        tokio::process::Command::new(shell)\n            .arg(shell_arg)\n            .arg(command)\n            .envs(env_vars)\n            .output(),\n    )\n    .await\n    .map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!(\"Hook execution timeout after {timeout_seconds} seconds\"))?\n    .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(\"Hook execution failed: {e}\"))?;\n\n    let duration = start_time.elapsed();\n\n    Ok(HookResult {\n        success: output.status.success(),\n        exit_code: output.status.code().unwrap_or(-1),\n        stdout: String::from_utf8_lossy(&amp;output.stdout).to_string(),\n        stderr: String::from_utf8_lossy(&amp;output.stderr).to_string(),\n        duration_ms: duration.as_millis() as u64,\n    })\n}\n\n/// Hook execution result\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct HookResult {\n    pub success: bool,\n    pub exit_code: i32,",

        "contents": "export class CodexExec {\nconstructor(executablePath: string | null = null) {\n\n  }\n\n  async *run(args: CodexExecArgs): AsyncGenerator&lt;string&gt; {\n    const commandArgs: string[] = [\"exec\", \"--experimental-json\"];\n\n    if (args.model) {\n      commandArgs.push(\"--model\", args.model);\n    }\n\n    if (args.sandboxMode) {\n      commandArgs.push(\"--sandbox\", args.sandboxMode);\n    }\n\n    if (args.workingDirectory) {\n      commandArgs.push(\"--cd\", args.workingDirectory);\n    }\n\n    if (args.skipGitRepoCheck) {\n      commandArgs.push(\"--skip-git-repo-check\");\n    }\n\n    if (args.outputSchemaFile) {\n      commandArgs.push(\"--output-schema\", args.outputSchemaFile);\n    }\n\n    if (args.images?.length) {\n      for (const image of args.images) {\n        commandArgs.push(\"--image\", image);\n      }\n    }\n\n    if (args.threadId) {\n      commandArgs.push(\"resume\", args.threadId);\n    }\n\n    const env = {\n      ...process.env,\n    };\n    if (!env[INTERNAL_ORIGINATOR_ENV]) {\n      env[INTERNAL_ORIGINATOR_ENV] = TYPESCRIPT_SDK_ORIGINATOR;\n    }\n    if (args.baseUrl) {\n      env.OPENAI_BASE_URL = args.baseUrl;\n    }\n    if (args.apiKey) {\n      env.CODEX_API_KEY = args.apiKey;\n    }\n\n    const child = spawn(this.executablePath, commandArgs, {\n      env,\n    });\n\n    let spawnError: unknown | null = null;\n    child.once(\"error\", (err) =&gt; (spawnError = err));\n\n    if (!child.stdin) {\n      child.kill();\n      throw new Error(\"Child process has no stdin\");\n    }\n    child.stdin.write(args.input);\n    child.stdin.end();\n\n    if (!child.stdout) {\n      child.kill();\n      throw new Error(\"Child process has no stdout\");\n    }\n    const stderrChunks: Buffer[] = [];\n\n    if (child.stderr) {\n      child.stderr.on(\"data\", (data) =&gt; {\n        stderrChunks.push(data);\n      });\n    }\n\n    const rl = readline.createInterface({\n      input: child.stdout,\n      crlfDelay: Infinity,\n    });\n\n    try {\n      for await (const line of rl)\n  }\n}",

{\n                if let Some(path) = parameters.get(\"path\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {\n                    self.check_file_read(Path::new(path))?;\n                }\n                if let Some(path) = parameters.get(\"target_file\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {\n                    self.check_file_read(Path::new(path))?;\n                }\n            }\n            \"write\" | \"search_replace\" | \"delete_file\" =&gt; {\n                if let Some(path) = parameters.get(\"file_path\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {\n                    self.check_file_write(Path::new(path))?;\n                }\n                if let Some(path) = parameters.get(\"target_file\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {\n                    self.check_file_write(Path::new(path))?;\n                }\n            }\n            \"web_search\" | \"fetch\" | \"http_request\" =&gt; {\n                if let Some(url) = parameters.get(\"url\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {\n                    self.check_network_access(url)?;\n                }\n                if let Some(_url) = parameters.get(\"search_term\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {\n                    // For web_search, check if https://* is allowed\n                    self.check_network_access(\"https://search.brave.com\")?;\n                }\n            }\n            \"run_terminal_cmd\" | \"shell\" | \"exec\" =&gt; {\n                if let Some(cmd) = parameters.get(\"command\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {\n                    self.check_shell_command(cmd)?;\n                }\n            }\n            _ =&gt; {\n                // Unknown tool - rely on MCP permission check above\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Get permission summary for logging\n    pub fn get_permission_summary(&amp;self) -&gt; String {\n        format!(\n            \"MCP: {:?}, FS(read:{}, write:{:?}), Net: {:?}, Shell: {:?}\"",

        "contents": "# Codex Tauri - セキュリティテストガイド\n\n実機でのセキュリティ検証手順\n\n---\n\n## 🔒 セキュリティテスト項目\n\n### 1. ファイルアクセス制限テスト\n\n#### テスト目的\nTauri allowlistによるファイルアクセスが適切に制限されているか確認\n\n#### テスト手順\n\n**Step 1: 許可されたパスへのアクセス（成功すべき）**\n\nFrontend Console（開発者ツール）で実行:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\n// 許可: $APPDATA/codex\nawait invoke('test_file_access', { \n  path: 'C:\\\\Users\\\\&lt;username&gt;\\\\AppData\\\\Roaming\\\\codex\\\\test.txt' \n})\n// → 成功すべき\n\n// 許可: ワークスペース\nawait invoke('test_file_access', { \n  path: 'C:\\\\Users\\\\&lt;username&gt;\\\\Projects\\\\myproject\\\\test.txt' \n})\n// → 成功すべき\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Step 2: 禁止されたパスへのアクセス（失敗すべき）**\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\n// 禁止: システムディレクトリ\nawait invoke('test_file_access', { \n  path: 'C:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\config\\\\SAM' \n})\n// → エラーになるべき\n\n// 禁止: 他のユーザーディレクトリ\nawait invoke('test_file_access', { \n  path: 'C:\\\\Users\\\\OtherUser\\\\Documents\\\\secret.txt' \n})\n// → エラーになるべき\n\n// 禁止: ルートディレクトリ\nawait invoke('test_file_access', { \n  path: 'C:\\\\' \n})\n// → エラーになるべき\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**期待結果**: 許可されたパス以外は全てエラー\n\n---\n\n### 2. Shell実行制限テスト\n\n#### テスト目的\nShell実行が完全に禁止されているか確認\n\n#### テスト手順\n\nFrontend Consoleで実行:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\n// 禁止: 任意のコマンド実行\nawait invoke('shell', { cmd: 'cmd.exe /c dir' })\n// → エラーになるべき\n\nawait invoke('shell', { cmd: 'powershell.exe -Command Get-Process' })\n// → エラーになるべき\n\n// 禁止: sidecar実行\nawait invoke('sidecar', { program: 'malicious.exe' })\n// → エラーになるべき\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**期待結果**: 全てエラー（Shell実行は完全禁止）\n\n---\n\n### 3. IPC通信セキュリティテスト\n\n#### テスト目的",

        "contents": "fn parse_skill_file(path: &amp;Path, scope: SkillScope) -&gt; Result&lt;SkillMetadata, SkillParseError&gt; {\n    let contents = fs::read_to_string(path).map_err(SkillParseError::Read)?;\n\n    let frontmatter = extract_frontmatter(&amp;contents).ok_or(SkillParseError::MissingFrontmatter)?;\n\n    let parsed: SkillFrontmatter =\n        serde_yaml::from_str(&amp;frontmatter).map_err(SkillParseError::InvalidYaml)?;\n\n    let name = sanitize_single_line(&amp;parsed.name);\n    let description = sanitize_single_line(&amp;parsed.description);\n    let short_description = parsed\n        .metadata\n        .short_description\n        .as_deref()\n        .map(sanitize_single_line)\n        .filter(|value| !value.is_empty());\n\n    validate_field(&amp;name, MAX_NAME_LEN, \"name\")?;\n    validate_field(&amp;description, MAX_DESCRIPTION_LEN, \"description\")?;\n    if let Some(short_description) = short_description.as_deref() {\n        validate_field(\n            short_description,\n            MAX_SHORT_DESCRIPTION_LEN,\n            \"metadata.short-description\",\n        )?;\n    }\n\n    let resolved_path = normalize_path(path).unwrap_or_else(|_| path.to_path_buf());\n\n    Ok(SkillMetadata {\n        name,\n        description,\n        short_description,\n        path: resolved_path,\n        scope,\n    })\n}\n\nfn sanitize_single_line(raw: &amp;str) -&gt; String {\n    raw.split_whitespace().collect::&lt;Vec&lt;_&gt;&gt;().join(\" \")\n}\n\nfn validate_field(\n    value: &amp;str,\n    max_len: usize,\n    field_name: &amp;'static str,\n) -&gt; Result&lt;(), SkillParseError&gt;         "contents": "fn is_write_patch_constrained_to_writable_paths(\n    action: &amp;ApplyPatchAction,\n    sandbox_policy: &amp;SandboxPolicy,\n    cwd: &amp;Path,\n) -&gt; bool {\n    // Early‑exit if there are no declared writable roots.\n    let writable_roots = match sandbox_policy {\n        SandboxPolicy::ReadOnly =&gt; {\n            return false;\n        }\n        SandboxPolicy::DangerFullAccess | SandboxPolicy::ExternalSandbox { .. } =&gt; {\n            return true;\n        }\n        SandboxPolicy::WorkspaceWrite { .. } =&gt; sandbox_policy.get_writable_roots_with_cwd(cwd),\n    };\n\n    // Normalize a path by removing &#96;.&#96; and resolving &#96;..&#96; without touching the\n    // filesystem (works even if the file does not exist).\n    fn normalize(path: &amp;Path) -&gt; Option&lt;PathBuf&gt; {\n        let mut out = PathBuf::new();\n        for comp in path.components() {\n            match comp {\n                Component::ParentDir =&gt; {\n                    out.pop();\n                }\n                Component::CurDir =&gt; { /* skip */ }\n                other =&gt; out.push(other.as_os_str()),\n            }\n        }\n        Some(out)\n    }\n\n    // Determine whether &#96;path&#96; is inside **any** writable root. Both &#96;path&#96;\n    // and roots are converted to absolute, normalized forms before the\n    // prefix check.\n    let is_path_writable = |p: &amp;PathBuf| {\n        let abs = resolve_path(cwd, p);\n        let abs = match normalize(&amp;abs) {\n            Some(v) =&gt; v,\n            None =&gt; return false,\n        };\n\n        writable_roots\n            .iter()\n            .any(|writable_root| writable_root.is_path_writable(&amp;abs))\n    };\n\n    for (path, change) in action.changes()",

        "contents": "}\n\nimpl SecurityMonitor {\n    pub fn new() -&gt; Self {\n        let mut dangerous_commands = HashSet::new();\n        dangerous_commands.extend(\n            [\n                \"rm\", \"rmdir\", \"del\", \"erase\", \"format\", \"fdisk\", \"mkfs\", \"dd\", \"shred\", \"wipe\",\n                \"srm\", \"sudo\", \"su\", \"chmod +x\", \"curl\", \"wget\", \"ssh\", \"scp\", \"ftp\", \"telnet\",\n            ]\n            .iter()\n            .map(|s| s.to_string()),\n        );\n\n        let dangerous_patterns = vec![\n            regex::Regex::new(r\"rm\\s+-rf\\s+/\").unwrap(),\n            regex::Regex::new(r\"dd\\s+if=\").unwrap(),\n            regex::Regex::new(r\"&gt;\\s*/dev/\").unwrap(),\n            regex::Regex::new(r\"chmod\\s+777\").unwrap(),\n        ];\n\n        Self {\n            dangerous_commands,\n            dangerous_patterns,\n            file_deletion_prevention: true,\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub fn is_command_safe(&amp;self, command: &amp;str, args: &amp;[String]) -&gt; Result&lt;bool&gt; {\n        let full_command = format!(\"{} {}\", command, args.join(\" \"));\n\n        // Check dangerous commands\n        if self.dangerous_commands.contains(command) {\n            return Ok(false);\n        }\n\n        // Check dangerous patterns\n        for pattern in &amp;self.dangerous_patterns {\n            if pattern.is_match(&amp;full_command) {\n                return Ok(false);\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(true)\n    }\n\n    pub fn is_file_operation_safe(&amp;self, operation: &amp;FileOperation) -&gt; bool {\n        match operation {\n            FileOperation::Delete(_) if self.file_deletion_prevention =&gt; false,\n            FileOperation::Write(path) if self.is_system_file(path) =&gt; false,\n            _ =&gt; true,\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn is_system_file(&amp;self, path: &amp;Path) -&gt; bool",

        "contents": "/// - Windows/UNC paths\n/// - shell-escaped single paths (via &#96;shlex&#96;)\npub fn normalize_pasted_path(pasted: &amp;str) -&gt; Option&lt;PathBuf&gt; {\n    let pasted = pasted.trim();\n\n    // file:// URL → filesystem path\n    if let Ok(url) = url::Url::parse(pasted)\n        &amp;&amp; url.scheme() == \"file\"\n    {\n        return url.to_file_path().ok();\n    }\n\n    // TODO: We'll improve the implementation/unit tests over time, as appropriate.\n    // Possibly use typed-path: https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/2567/commits/3cc92b78e0a1f94e857cf4674d3a9db918ed352e\n    //\n    // Detect unquoted Windows paths and bypass POSIX shlex which\n    // treats backslashes as escapes (e.g., C:\\Users\\Alice\\file.png).\n    // Also handles UNC paths (\\\\server\\share\\path).\n    let looks_like_windows_path = {\n        // Drive letter path: C:\\ or C:/\n        let drive = pasted\n            .chars()\n            .next()\n            .map(|c| c.is_ascii_alphabetic())\n            .unwrap_or(false)\n            &amp;&amp; pasted.get(1..2) == Some(\":\")\n            &amp;&amp; pasted\n                .get(2..3)\n                .map(|s| s == \"\\\\\" || s == \"/\")\n                .unwrap_or(false);\n        // UNC path: \\\\server\\share\n        let unc = pasted.starts_with(\"\\\\\\\\\");\n        drive || unc\n    };\n    if looks_like_windows_path {\n        #[cfg(target_os = \"linux\")]\n        {\n            if is_probably_wsl()\n                &amp;&amp; let Some(converted) = convert_windows_path_to_wsl(pasted)\n            {\n                return Some(converted);\n            }\n        }\n        return Some(PathBuf::from(pasted));\n    }\n\n    // shell-escaped single path → unescaped\n    let parts: Vec&lt;String&gt; = shlex::Shlex::new(pasted).collect();\n    if parts.len() == 1 {\n        return parts.into_iter().next().map(PathBuf::from);\n    }\n\n    None\n}\n\n#[cfg(target_os = \"linux\")]\npub(crate) fn is_probably_wsl() -&gt; bool {\n    // Primary: Check /proc/version for \"microsoft\" or \"WSL\" (most reliable for standard WSL).",

        "contents": "# 🔒 Codex環境変数設定テンプレート\n# バージョン: v0.56.0-zapabob\n# 作成日: 2025-11-02\n# \n# 使用方法:\n#   1. このファイルをプロジェクトルートに .env としてコピー\n#      PowerShell: Copy-Item zapabob\\templates\\env.template .env\n#      Bash: cp zapabob/templates/env.template .env\n#   2. 各APIキーの値を実際の値に置き換える\n#   3. パーミッション設定（Linux/macOS）: chmod 600 .env\n#\n# 注意事項:\n#   - .envファイルは.gitignoreに追加されており、Gitにコミットされません\n#   - APIキーは絶対に公開しないでください\n#   - 定期的にAPIキーをローテーションしてください\n\n# ==================== 必須設定 ====================\n\n# OpenAI APIキー（Codex専用、最優先）\n# 取得先: https://platform.openai.com/api-keys\n# 形式: sk-proj-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX\n# 優先度: 🥇 最優先（環境変数の中で最も優先される）\nCODEX_API_KEY=\n\n# OpenAI APIキー（汎用、CODEX_API_KEY未設定時のフォールバック）\n# 取得先: https://platform.openai.com/api-keys\n# 形式: sk-proj-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX\n# 優先度: 🥉 フォールバック\nOPENAI_API_KEY=\n\n# ==================== MCP Server用APIキー（任意） ====================\n\n# GitHub Personal Access Token（GitHub MCP Server用）\n# 取得先: https://github.com/settings/tokens\n# 必要なスコープ: repo, read:user\n# 形式: ghp_XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX\n# 用途: PR/Issue管理、コード検索\nGITHUB_TOKEN=\n\n# Google Gemini APIキー（Gemini MCP Server用）\n# 取得先: https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey\n# 形式: AIzaSyXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX\n# 用途: Google AI、Google Search Grounding\nGEMINI_API_KEY=\n\n# Google AI Studio APIキー（GEMINI_API_KEYの代替）\n# 取得先: https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey\n# 形式: AIzaSyXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX\n# 優先度: GEMINI_API_KEYが優先される\n# GOOGLE_AI_STUDIO_API_KEY=\n\n# Brave Search APIキー（Brave Search MCP Server用）\n# 取得先: https://brave.com/search/api/\n# 形式: BSA_XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "use chrono::DateTime;\nuse chrono::Utc;\nuse serde::Deserialize;\nuse serde::Serialize;\nuse sha2::Digest;\nuse sha2::Sha256;\nuse std::fmt::Debug;\nuse std::fs::File;\nuse std::fs::OpenOptions;\nuse std::io::Read;\nuse std::io::Write;\n#[cfg(unix)]\nuse std::os::unix::fs::OpenOptionsExt;\nuse std::path::Path;\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse tracing::warn;\n\nuse crate::token_data::TokenData;\nuse codex_keyring_store::DefaultKeyringStore;\nuse codex_keyring_store::KeyringStore;\n\n/// Determine where Codex should store CLI auth credentials.\n#[derive(Debug, Default, Copy, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]\n#[serde(rename_all = \"lowercase\")]\npub enum AuthCredentialsStoreMode {\n    #[default]\n    /// Persist credentials in CODEX_HOME/auth.json.\n    File,\n    /// Persist credentials in the keyring. Fail if unavailable.\n    Keyring,\n    /// Use keyring when available; otherwise, fall back to a file in CODEX_HOME.\n    Auto,\n}\n\n/// Expected structure for $CODEX_HOME/auth.json.\n#[derive(Deserialize, Serialize, Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]\npub struct AuthDotJson {\n    #[serde(rename = \"OPENAI_API_KEY\")]\n    pub openai_api_key: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n\n    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = \"Option::is_none\")]\n    pub tokens: Option&lt;TokenData&gt;,\n\n    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = \"Option::is_none\")]\n    pub last_refresh: Option&lt;DateTime&lt;Utc&gt;&gt;,\n}\n\npub(super) fn get_auth_file(codex_home: &amp;Path) -&gt; PathBuf {\n    codex_home.join(\"auth.json\")\n}\n\npub(super) fn delete_file_if_exists(codex_home: &amp;Path) -&gt; std::io::Result&lt;bool&gt; {\n    let auth_file = get_auth_file(codex_home);\n    match std::fs::remove_file(&amp;auth_file) {\n        Ok(()) =&gt; Ok(true),\n        Err(err) if err.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound =&gt; Ok(false),\n        Err(err) =&gt; Err(err),\n    }\n}\n\npub(super) trait AuthStorageBackend: Debug + Send + Sync",

        "contents": "# 🔒 Codex環境変数設定テンプレート\n# バージョン: v0.56.0-zapabob\n# 作成日: 2025-11-02\n# \n# 使用方法:\n#   1. このファイルをプロジェクトルートに .env としてコピー\n#      PowerShell: Copy-Item zapabob\\templates\\env.template .env\n#      Bash: cp zapabob/templates/env.template .env\n#   2. 各APIキーの値を実際の値に置き換える\n#   3. パーミッション設定（Linux/macOS）: chmod 600 .env\n#\n# 注意事項:\n#   - .envファイルは.gitignoreに追加されており、Gitにコミットされません\n#   - APIキーは絶対に公開しないでください\n#   - 定期的にAPIキーをローテーションしてください\n\n# ==================== 必須設定 ====================\n\n# OpenAI APIキー（Codex専用、最優先）\n# 取得先: https://platform.openai.com/api-keys\n# 形式: sk-proj-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX\n# 優先度: 🥇 最優先（環境変数の中で最も優先される）\nCODEX_API_KEY=\n\n# OpenAI APIキー（汎用、CODEX_API_KEY未設定時のフォールバック）\n# 取得先: https://platform.openai.com/api-keys\n# 形式: sk-proj-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX\n# 優先度: 🥉 フォールバック\nOPENAI_API_KEY=\n\n# ==================== MCP Server用APIキー（任意） ====================\n\n# GitHub Personal Access Token（GitHub MCP Server用）\n# 取得先: https://github.com/settings/tokens\n# 必要なスコープ: repo, read:user\n# 形式: ghp_XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX\n# 用途: PR/Issue管理、コード検索\nGITHUB_TOKEN=\n\n# Google Gemini APIキー（Gemini MCP Server用）\n# 取得先: https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey\n# 形式: AIzaSyXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX\n# 用途: Google AI、Google Search Grounding\nGEMINI_API_KEY=\n\n# Google AI Studio APIキー（GEMINI_API_KEYの代替）\n# 取得先: https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey\n# 形式: AIzaSyXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX\n# 優先度: GEMINI_API_KEYが優先される\n# GOOGLE_AI_STUDIO_API_KEY=",

        "contents": "# ====================\n# Codex Environment Variables Template\n# ====================\n# 📋 使い方 / Usage:\n#   1. このファイルを .env にコピー: copy env.template .env\n#   2. 各環境変数に実際の値を設定\n#   3. .env ファイルは公開しないこと（.gitignoreに追加済み）\n\n# ====================\n# 🔑 OpenAI API (REQUIRED)\n# ====================\n# OpenAI APIキー（必須）\n# 取得方法: https://platform.openai.com/api-keys\n# \n# 注意: sk-proj- で始まるProject APIキーを使用してください\nOPENAI_API_KEY=sk-proj-YOUR_API_KEY_HERE\n\n# ====================\n# 🐙 GitHub Integration (REQUIRED)\n# ====================\n# GitHub Personal Access Token（必須）\n# 取得方法: https://github.com/settings/tokens\n# \n# 必要なスコープ:\n#   - repo: フルリポジトリアクセス\n#   - read:org: 組織情報の読み取り\n#   - workflow: GitHub Actionsワークフローの管理\n#   - gist: Gistの作成・管理（オプション）\nGITHUB_TOKEN=ghp_YOUR_GITHUB_TOKEN_HERE\n\n# ====================\n# 📢 Slack Integration (OPTIONAL)\n# ====================\n# Slack Webhook URL（オプション - タスク完了通知用）\n# 取得方法: https://api.slack.com/messaging/webhooks\n# \n# セットアップ手順:\n#   1. Slack Appを作成\n#   2. Incoming Webhooksを有効化\n#   3. Webhook URLを取得\n#   4. 以下に設定\nSLACK_WEBHOOK_URL=https://hooks.slack.com/services/YOUR/WEBHOOK/URL\n\n# ====================\n# 🔍 Brave Search (OPTIONAL)\n# ====================\n# Brave Search API Key（オプション）\n# 取得方法: https://api.search.brave.com/\n# \n# 注意: 現在config.tomlで disabled=true に設定されています\n#       使用する場合は config.toml の [mcp_servers.brave-search] の\n#       disabled = true 行を削除してください\nBRAVE_API_KEY=YOUR_BRAVE_API_KEY_HERE\n\n# ====================\n# ☁️ Upstash Context7 (OPTIONAL)\n# ====================\n# Upstash Redis REST API（オプション - コンテキスト管理用）",

        "contents": "use chrono::DateTime;\nuse chrono::Utc;\nuse serde::Deserialize;\nuse serde::Serialize;\nuse sha2::Digest;\nuse sha2::Sha256;\nuse std::fmt::Debug;\nuse std::fs::File;\nuse std::fs::OpenOptions;\nuse std::io::Read;\nuse std::io::Write;\n#[cfg(unix)]\nuse std::os::unix::fs::OpenOptionsExt;\nuse std::path::Path;\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse tracing::warn;\n\nuse crate::token_data::TokenData;\nuse codex_keyring_store::DefaultKeyringStore;\nuse codex_keyring_store::KeyringStore;\n\n/// Determine where Codex should store CLI auth credentials.\n#[derive(Debug, Default, Copy, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]\n#[serde(rename_all = \"lowercase\")]\npub enum AuthCredentialsStoreMode {\n    #[default]\n    /// Persist credentials in CODEX_HOME/auth.json.\n    File,\n    /// Persist credentials in the keyring. Fail if unavailable.\n    Keyring,\n    /// Use keyring when available; otherwise, fall back to a file in CODEX_HOME.\n    Auto,\n}\n\n/// Expected structure for $CODEX_HOME/auth.json.\n#[derive(Deserialize, Serialize, Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]\npub struct AuthDotJson {\n    #[serde(rename = \"OPENAI_API_KEY\")]\n    pub openai_api_key: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n\n    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = \"Option::is_none\")]\n    pub tokens: Option&lt;TokenData&gt;,\n\n    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = \"Option::is_none\")]\n    pub last_refresh: Option&lt;DateTime&lt;Utc&gt;&gt;,\n}\n\npub(super) fn get_auth_file(codex_home: &amp;Path) -&gt; PathBuf {\n    codex_home.join(\"auth.json\")\n}\n\npub(super) fn delete_file_if_exists(codex_home: &amp;Path) -&gt; std::io::Result&lt;bool&gt; {\n    let auth_file = get_auth_file(codex_home);\n    match std::fs::remove_file(&amp;auth_file) {\n        Ok(()) =&gt; Ok(true),\n        Err(err) if err.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound =&gt; Ok(false),\n        Err(err) =&gt; Err(err),\n    }\n}\n\npub(super) trait AuthStorageBackend: Debug + Send + Sync",

        "contents": "# ====================\n# Codex Environment Variables Template\n# ====================\n# 📋 使い方 / Usage:\n#   1. このファイルを .env にコピー: copy env.template .env\n#   2. 各環境変数に実際の値を設定\n#   3. .env ファイルは公開しないこと（.gitignoreに追加済み）\n\n# ====================\n# 🔑 OpenAI API (REQUIRED)\n# ====================\n# OpenAI APIキー（必須）\n# 取得方法: https://platform.openai.com/api-keys\n# \n# 注意: sk-proj- で始まるProject APIキーを使用してください\nOPENAI_API_KEY=sk-proj-YOUR_API_KEY_HERE\n\n# ====================\n# 🐙 GitHub Integration (REQUIRED)\n# ====================\n# GitHub Personal Access Token（必須）\n# 取得方法: https://github.com/settings/tokens\n# \n# 必要なスコープ:\n#   - repo: フルリポジトリアクセス\n#   - read:org: 組織情報の読み取り\n#   - workflow: GitHub Actionsワークフローの管理\n#   - gist: Gistの作成・管理（オプション）\nGITHUB_TOKEN=ghp_YOUR_GITHUB_TOKEN_HERE\n\n# ====================\n# 📢 Slack Integration (OPTIONAL)\n# ====================\n# Slack Webhook URL（オプション - タスク完了通知用）\n# 取得方法: https://api.slack.com/messaging/webhooks\n# \n# セットアップ手順:\n#   1. Slack Appを作成\n#   2. Incoming Webhooksを有効化\n#   3. Webhook URLを取得\n#   4. 以下に設定\nSLACK_WEBHOOK_URL=https://hooks.slack.com/services/YOUR/WEBHOOK/URL\n\n# ====================\n# 🔍 Brave Search (OPTIONAL)\n# ====================\n# Brave Search API Key（オプション）\n# 取得方法: https://api.search.brave.com/\n# \n# 注意: 現在config.tomlで disabled=true に設定されています\n#       使用する場合は config.toml の [mcp_servers.brave-search] の\n#       disabled = true 行を削除してください\nBRAVE_API_KEY=YOUR_BRAVE_API_KEY_HERE\n\n# ====================\n# ☁️ Upstash Context7 (OPTIONAL)\n# ====================\n# Upstash Redis REST API（オプション - コンテキスト管理用）",

        "contents": "            })\n    }\n\n    fn get_current_auth_json(&amp;self) -&gt; Option&lt;AuthDotJson&gt; {\n        #[expect(clippy::unwrap_used)]\n        self.auth_dot_json.lock().unwrap().clone()\n    }\n\n    fn get_current_token_data(&amp;self) -&gt; Option&lt;TokenData&gt; {\n        self.get_current_auth_json().and_then(|t| t.tokens)\n    }\n\n    /// Consider this private to integration tests.\n    pub fn create_dummy_chatgpt_auth_for_testing() -&gt; Self {\n        let auth_dot_json = AuthDotJson {\n            openai_api_key: None,\n            tokens: Some(TokenData {\n                id_token: Default::default(),\n                access_token: \"Access Token\".to_string(),\n                refresh_token: \"test\".to_string(),\n                account_id: Some(\"account_id\".to_string()),\n            }),\n            last_refresh: Some(Utc::now()),\n        };\n\n        let auth_dot_json = Arc::new(Mutex::new(Some(auth_dot_json)));\n        Self {\n            api_key: None,\n            mode: AuthMode::ChatGPT,\n            storage: create_auth_storage(PathBuf::new(), AuthCredentialsStoreMode::File),\n            auth_dot_json,\n            client: crate::default_client::create_client(),\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn from_api_key_with_client(api_key: &amp;str, client: CodexHttpClient) -&gt; Self {\n        Self {\n            api_key: Some(api_key.to_owned()),\n            mode: AuthMode::ApiKey,\n            storage: create_auth_storage(PathBuf::new(), AuthCredentialsStoreMode::File),\n            auth_dot_json: Arc::new(Mutex::new(None)),\n            client,\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub fn from_api_key(api_key: &amp;str) -&gt; Self {\n        Self::from_api_key_with_client(api_key, crate::default_client::create_client())\n    }\n}\n\npub const OPENAI_API_KEY_ENV_VAR: &amp;str = \"OPENAI_API_KEY\";\npub const CODEX_API_KEY_ENV_VAR: &amp;str = \"CODEX_API_KEY\";\n\npub fn read_openai_api_key_from_env() -&gt; Option&lt;String&gt;",
